Terms and Conditions

Upgrade to Business Class Terms and Conditions:

The following terms and conditions ("Terms and Conditions") shall apply to a bid (“Offer”) made by you (“Guest, you”) to KENYA AIRWAYS LTD (“Airline”) for an opportunity to upgrade an economy class ticket that you originally purchased for travel with the Airline to business class (“Upgrade”).

You shall be deemed to have the authority to act on behalf of and to bind the person or persons named or included on the Offer to these Terms and Conditions.

What do I need to rebook myself?

Where do I go to rebook my flight?

Simply visit the Kenya Airways website(Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/ ), select “Manage Booking”

Where do I find the flight options available for rebooking?

Can I rebook a flight that hasn’t been disrupted?

Can I offer different amounts for the Upgrade for each segment of my journey?

Yes, you can offer different amounts for each eligible segment.

How much does it cost to make an offer?

The offer is free of charge. Only if you receive the Upgrade, your credit card will be debited with the amount of your offer. Please, we still need your credit card details at the time of making your offer for standard verification purposes.

Can I change my Offer to a higher or lower amount?

Yes, you can change the amount before you receive a confirmation email informing you whether your Offer has been successful or not. All you need to do to change your Offer is to use the link from the upgrade offer email.

Apart from the Upgrade amount displayed, will there be additional taxes or charges?

No.

What happens if an Offer has been submitted, but the flight has to be changed or cancelled?

You may change or cancel your offer up to 13 hours before departure.

What happens if your Upgrade has been accepted, but you have to cancel your trip?

After your offer has been accepted, the Upgrade amount is no longer refundable.

What happens if your upgrade has been accepted, but KQ cancels your flight?

Your Upgrade remains valid if you a re-booked to another KQ flight at the same amount. Otherwise, we will refund the amount.

What happens if an Offer was cancelled by mistake?

Up to 13 hours before departure you may cancel, correct your offer or re-offer.

Is the time of making the Offer decisive for its ranking?

No.

Does the Kenya Airways Upgrade to Business Class apply to the round trip? Can I choose any amount I want for my Upgrade offer?

The system has a default minimum and maximum bid amount set. It will not accept any offer lower than the minimum amount or higher than the maximum amount. my flight has been canceled/rescheduled. Does that mean I have been rebooked?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight. If you are happy with the new flight details highlighted on the email, click on “ACCEPT CHANGES”

However, if you would like to see more flight options, go to the Kenya Airways website and click on Manage my booking where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

If my outbound flight has been changed, can I also change the inbound flight free of charge?

No. With the self-rebooking tool, you will only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors. If you wish to change the inbound because you lost a day(s) on the outbound, you will have to reach out to your travel agent or our Contact center office.

If checked-in, will the bags be transferred automatically to the new flight?

Yes, they will be transferred automatically.

Does the tool rebook other airlines document with KQ sectors like DL or AF?

Yes, it does. However, instead of revalidation, the ticket will be reissued.

Does the tool rebook award tickets?

Yes, it does

What happens if a flight is disrupted more than once?

You can self-rebook once per every disruption.

By taking advantage of this service, you can bypass long lines at selected airports and even pick your preferred seat. Once completed, you can print your boarding pass at your convenience. When you arrive at the airport, use the designated online check-in drop-off point for your luggage and then proceed to the boarding gate. Kenya Airways has taken online check-in to new heights, providing a smoother and more convenient experience.

International Check-in:

For international flights, it is mandatory for all passengers to complete the check-in process a minimum of two and a half hours before the flight's departure, regardless of the travel class. The check-in counters close precisely one hour before the scheduled departure time.

Domestic Check-in:

Passengers traveling on domestic flights must present a valid form of identification during check-in. It is required to complete the check-in process at least one and a half hours prior to departure, regardless of the travel class. The check-in counters close half an hour before takeoff.

Passengers traveling on domestic flights must present a valid form of identification during check-in. It is required to complete the check-in process at least one and a half hours prior to departure, regardless of the travel class. The check-in counters close half an hour before takeoff.

Do I need to call Kenya Airways to reconfirm my flight?

If your booking is successful, there is no need to call us. You can check in online or at the airport on the day of departure.

What is an Extra Legroom Seat?

The extra Legroom Seats are located in Economy Class exit rows with a generous space for you to stretch out. It is offered only on Kenya Airways-operated flights and is not available on flights operated by our partner airlines.

Extra Legroom Seats are subject to availability, terms & conditions, and other eligibility requirements. Please view all requirements before making your purchase to ensure you meet all of the criteria.

Who can book an Extra Legroom Seat?

Below is a summary of the eligibility requirements.

Guest must:

[List level 1] - Be physically able to reach, locate and operate the emergency exit window or door, and to quickly pass through the exit.

[List level 1] - Be able to understand and acknowledge instructions in English.

[List level 1] - Be aged 18 years or older and not have any conditions.

criteria.criterion: If automatic rebooking is acceptable, select Accept Changes.
anchors: DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES
mapped_evidence_text:
my flight has been canceled/rescheduled. Does that mean I have been rebooked?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight. If you are happy with the new flight details highlighted on the email, click on “ACCEPT CHANGES”

However, if you would like to see more flight options, go to the Kenya Airways website and click on Manage my booking where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

If my outbound flight has been changed, can I also change the inbound flight free of charge?

No. With the self-rebooking tool, you will only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors. If you wish to change the inbound because you lost a day(s) on the outbound, you will have to reach out to your travel agent or our Contact center office.

If checked-in, will the bags be transferred automatically to the new flight?

Yes, they will be transferred automatically.

Does the tool rebook other airlines document with KQ sectors like DL or AF?

Yes, it does. However, instead of revalidation, the ticket will be reissued.

Does the tool rebook award tickets?

Yes, it does

What happens if a flight is disrupted more than once?

You can self-rebook once per every disruption.

criteria.criterion: KQ may refuse carriage of the passenger and baggage if the passenger refuses the requested security search or scan.
anchors: may refuse to carry you and your Baggage
mapped_evidence_text:
we may refuse to carry you and your Baggage. In the event a search or scan causes Damage to you, or an x-ray or scan causes damage to your Baggage, we shall not be liable for such Damage unless due to our fault or negligence.

8.6 Checked Baggage

8.6.1 Upon delivery to us of your Baggage which you wish to check, we will take custody of, and issue a Baggage Identification Tag for, each piece of your Checked Baggage.

8.6.2 Checked Baggage must have your name or other personal identification affixed to it.

8.6.3 Checked Baggage will, whenever possible, be carried on the same aircraft as you, unless we decide for safety, security or operational reasons to carry it on an alternative flight. If your Checked Baggage is carried on a subsequent flight we will deliver it to you, unless applicable law requires you to be present for customs clearance.

8.7 Unchecked Baggage

8.7.1 We may specify maximum dimensions and/or weight for Baggage which you carry on to the aircraft. If we have not done so, Baggage which you carry onto the aircraft must fit under the seat in front of you or in an enclosed storage compartment in the cabin of the aircraft. If your Baggage cannot be stored in this manner, or is of excessive weight, or is considered unsafe for any reason, it must be carried as Checked Baggage, subject to Articles 8.2 and 8.3.

8.4 Right to Refuse Carriage

8.4.1 Subject to Articles 8.3.2 and 8.3.3, we will refuse to carry as Baggage the items described in Article 8.3, and we may refuse further carriage of any such items upon discovery.

8.4.2 We may refuse to carry as Baggage any item reasonably considered by us to be unsuitable for carriage because of its size, shape, weight, content or character, or for safety or operational reasons, or in the interests of the comfort of other passengers. Information about unacceptable items is available upon request.

8.4.3 We may refuse to accept Baggage for carriage unless it is in our reasonable opinion properly and securely packed in suitable containers. Information about packing and containers unacceptable to us is available upon request.

8.5 Right of Search

For reasons of safety and security we may request that you permit a search and scan of your person and a search, scan or x-ray of your Baggage. criteria.criterion: Already checked-in bags are transferred automatically to the new flight under the self-rebooking policy.
anchors: they will be transferred automatically
mapped_evidence_text:
my flight has been canceled/rescheduled. Does that mean I have been rebooked?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight. If you are happy with the new flight details highlighted on the email, click on “ACCEPT CHANGES”

However, if you would like to see more flight options, go to the Kenya Airways website and click on Manage my booking where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

If my outbound flight has been changed, can I also change the inbound flight free of charge?

No. With the self-rebooking tool, you will only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors. If you wish to change the inbound because you lost a day(s) on the outbound, you will have to reach out to your travel agent or our Contact center office.

If checked-in, will the bags be transferred automatically to the new flight?

Yes, they will be transferred automatically.

Does the tool rebook other airlines document with KQ sectors like DL or AF?

Yes, it does. However, instead of revalidation, the ticket will be reissued.

Does the tool rebook award tickets?

Yes, it does

What happens if a flight is disrupted more than once?

You can self-rebook once per every disruption.

criteria.criterion: The self-rebooking tool only changes disrupted sectors free of charge.
anchors: only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors
mapped_evidence_text:
my flight has been canceled/rescheduled. Does that mean I have been rebooked?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight. If you are happy with the new flight details highlighted on the email, click on “ACCEPT CHANGES”

However, if you would like to see more flight options, go to the Kenya Airways website and click on Manage my booking where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

If my outbound flight has been changed, can I also change the inbound flight free of charge?

No. With the self-rebooking tool, you will only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors. If you wish to change the inbound because you lost a day(s) on the outbound, you will have to reach out to your travel agent or our Contact center office.

If checked-in, will the bags be transferred automatically to the new flight?

Yes, they will be transferred automatically.

Does the tool rebook other airlines document with KQ sectors like DL or AF?

Yes, it does. However, instead of revalidation, the ticket will be reissued.

Does the tool rebook award tickets?

Yes, it does

What happens if a flight is disrupted more than once?

You can self-rebook once per every disruption.

and the Ticket indicates that there is a restriction on refund, we shall make a refund only to the person who paid for the Ticket, or to that person's order.

10.1.3 Refunds will only be made Subject to the ticket rules.

10.2 INVOLUNTARY REFUNDS

10.2.1 If we cancel a flight, fail to operate a flight reasonably according to schedule, fail to stop at your destination or Stopover, or cause you to miss a connecting flight on which you hold a reservation, the amount of the refund shall be:

10.3.1 If you are entitled to a refund of your Ticket for reasons other than those set out in Article 10.2, the amount of the refund shall be:

10.3.1.2 if a portion of the Ticket has been used, the refund will be an amount equal to the difference between the fare paid and the applicable fare for travel between the points for which the Ticket has been used, less any reasonable service charges or cancellation fees.

10.4.1 We may refuse a refund where application is made after the expiry of the validity of the Ticket.

By optig for online check-in, you're not just saving time; you're ensuring a smooth and stress-free start to your journey. Say goodbye to long lines and hello to an effortless way to prepare for your flight

When can I Check in?

Online Check-in:

With an electronic ticket, online check-in can be performed from 48 hours up until 1 hour before departure. By taking advantage of this service, you can bypass long lines at selected airports and even pick your preferred seat. Once completed, you can print your boarding pass at your convenience. When you arrive at the airport, use the designated online check-in drop-off point for your luggage and then proceed to the boarding gate. Pet Carriage

Pet Carriage website link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/pet-carriage/

Live animals will not be accepted as checked-in Animal in Hold (AVIH) or Pet in Cabin (PETC) on Kenya Airways flights.

Live animals shall be consigned as cargo only.

Exception

Service Dog

Service dog shall be accepted in the cabin if it’s providing assistance to a person with disability i.e. Blind guest, a person with mental or psychiatric disorder. The dog is certified and individually trained to provide assistance to a person with a disability.

For more information on health and import documents needed to transport a service dog, contact KQ Cargo for guidance.

Note: All service dogs must be trained to be accepted. Emotional support dogs are no longer considered as service animals.

Passengers with physical, sensory, psychiatric, intellectual, or other mental disabilities who need to travel with a service dog may be required to present certain documentation from a licensed medical health professional that is treating the passenger, dated within one year, stating that the service dog is necessary for the passenger/s mental health or treatment during air travel and/or any activity at the passengers’ destination.

Service Dogs are:

criteria.criterion: Yes, the disruption self-rebooking tool supports award tickets.
anchors: Does the tool rebook award tickets?
mapped_evidence_text:
my flight has been canceled/rescheduled. Does that mean I have been rebooked?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight. If you are happy with the new flight details highlighted on the email, click on “ACCEPT CHANGES”

However, if you would like to see more flight options, go to the Kenya Airways website and click on Manage my booking where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

If my outbound flight has been changed, can I also change the inbound flight free of charge?

No. With the self-rebooking tool, you will only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors. If you wish to change the inbound because you lost a day(s) on the outbound, you will have to reach out to your travel agent or our Contact center office.

If checked-in, will the bags be transferred automatically to the new flight?

Yes, they will be transferred automatically.

Does the tool rebook other airlines document with KQ sectors like DL or AF?

Yes, it does. However, instead of revalidation, the ticket will be reissued.

Does the tool rebook award tickets?

Yes, it does

What happens if a flight is disrupted more than once?

You can self-rebook once per every disruption.

Baggage Restrictions

Link to Baggage Restrictions website page: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/baggage-restrictions/

Please ensure that you do not pack items specified in this list in your carry-on or checked baggage.

Medically necessary needles and syringes are exempt from these prohibitions if passengers have in their possession prescription medication with a professionally printed label that identifies the medical office, pharmacy, or manufacturer of the medication.

Prohibited Items

For the safety of our passengers and aircraft, passengers are prohibited from carrying the following items in either checked or hand baggage:

[List level 1] - Explosives, munitions, fireworks, and flares

[List level 1] - Security-type cases/boxes incorporating goods such as lithium batteries or pyrotechnics

[List level 1] - Compressed gases (flammable, non-flammable, or poisonous) such as butane, propane, aqualung cylinders, lighter fuels, or refills

[List level 1] - Oxidizing substances such as bleaching powder and peroxides

[List level 1] - Flammable liquids such as paints and adhesives

[List level 1] - Disabling devices such as mace or pepper sprays, with irritant properties

[List level 1] - Poisons such as arsenic, cyanides, or insecticides

[List level 1] - Radioactive materials

[List level 1] - Corrosive materials such as mercury (which may be contained in thermometers or blood pressure gauges,) acids, alkalis, and wet cell batteries

mapped_evidence_text:
conditions.

[List level 1] - For acceptance of special baggage the conditions of carriage applies.

[List level 1] - For some types of special baggage advance reservations should be made or Kenya Airways may refuse acceptance if deemed necessary.

[List level 1] - If accepted, baggage shall be packed by the passenger in such a way that the item and/or its contents are sufficiently protected to endure ordinary handling.

[List level 1] - Odd size baggage cannot always be accepted. Acceptance depends on the capacity of the aircraft operating on the passenger’s routing. If the baggage cannot be accommodated on one of the aircraft, it cannot be accepted for the whole route. The reply to the SSR shall then be UN, in which case the sale agents shall inform the passenger immediately.

[List level 1] - When a passenger presents special baggage for check-in, the Customer Service Agent shall check the PNR of the passenger to verify whether transportation has been granted.

[List level 1] - If the special clearance is missing in the customer records, the station shall decide to accept it for transport, provided KQ procedures are strictly adhered to.

More Information

Bulky Baggage:

[List level 1] - For any baggage whose dimensions are larger than 300cm (Length +Width height) or heavier than 32kgs authorization shall be given prior travel by the commercial team. Lower limitation may apply for sports equipment.

Bulky Baggage:

[List level 1] - For any baggage whose dimensions are larger than 300cm (Length +Width height) or heavier than 32kgs authorization shall be given prior travel by the commercial team. Lower limitation may apply for sports equipment.

[List level 1] - Authorization will appear in the PNR with “XBAG comment”. If the baggage exceeds 32kgs or 300cms a “bulky XBAG transportation” message specifying the type and the dimensions is sent to the station.

[List level 1] - There is no weight limitation for wheelchair and mobility device however a comment has to be given on the PNR to enable plan for the right aircraft and ground handling process.

Fragile Baggage:

[List level 1] - Kenya Airways accepts no liability for fragile baggage, baggage with fragile contents, perishable items e-g food, meat, flowers etc. and Valuable. This information should be given to the passenger before accepting of such items.

[List level 1] - For fragile baggage the item shall be packed properly (original sealed box or suitable case) in order to endure normal handling. Mark “fragile” on the limited release part of the bag and a fragile sticker is affix on to the bag.

[List level 1] - Where perishable items require controlled temperature or specialized handling, passengers should be advised to transport as cargo.

[List level 1] - The passenger is responsible for ensuring the conformity of the health documents required for the trip and for hermetically packing in order to prevent any leaks, drips or odor.

Self Rebooking (FAQs)

What is the KQ Self Rebooking Service?

It is a self-service option by Kenya Airways that allows you to rebook your flight easily in case your flight is canceled or rescheduled.

Will I be charged to use the self-rebooking service?

No, The service is absolutely free.

Will my flight preferences and services remain the same?

You only need your booking reference or e-ticket number.

criteria.criterion: If the passenger cannot or does not self-rebook, the system automatically rebooks them on the next available flight.
anchors: automatically rebook you on the next available flight
mapped_evidence_text:
allowances.

What do I need to rebook myself?

You only need your booking reference or e-ticket number.

Where do I go to rebook my flight?

Simply visit the Kenya Airways website(Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/ ), select “Manage Booking”

You will find the rebooking link at the top marked “Click here.

Where do I find the flight options available for rebooking?

Once you log in, you will be redirected to a page that has all available flight options and timings.

*Flight timings available for rebooking are either less than 24 hours from your original flight or 7 days after.

Can I rebook a flight that hasn’t been disrupted?

No. Only flights with a schedule change i.e. delayed or canceled are open for self-rebooking.

What happens if I do not rebook myself/are not able to rebook?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight, after which you will receive an email with your new flight details.

Will I receive my e-ticket and boarding pass?

Yes, after you have selected and confirmed your new flight, you will receive an email confirmation as well as your e-ticket.

I have received an email that my flight has been canceled/rescheduled. Does that mean I have been rebooked?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight. If you are happy with the new flight details highlighted on the email, click on “ACCEPT CHANGES”

my flight has been canceled/rescheduled. Does that mean I have been rebooked?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight. If you are happy with the new flight details highlighted on the email, click on “ACCEPT CHANGES”

However, if you would like to see more flight options, go to the Kenya Airways website and click on Manage my booking where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

If my outbound flight has been changed, can I also change the inbound flight free of charge?

No. With the self-rebooking tool, you will only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors. If you wish to change the inbound because you lost a day(s) on the outbound, you will have to reach out to your travel agent or our Contact center office.

If checked-in, will the bags be transferred automatically to the new flight?

Yes, they will be transferred automatically.

Does the tool rebook other airlines document with KQ sectors like DL or AF?

Yes, it does. However, instead of revalidation, the ticket will be reissued.

Does the tool rebook award tickets?

Yes, it does

What happens if a flight is disrupted more than once?

You can self-rebook once per every disruption.

8.4 Right to Refuse Carriage

8.4.1 Subject to Articles 8.3.2 and 8.3.3, we will refuse to carry as Baggage the items described in Article 8.3, and we may refuse further carriage of any such items upon discovery.

8.4.2 We may refuse to carry as Baggage any item reasonably considered by us to be unsuitable for carriage because of its size, shape, weight, content or character, or for safety or operational reasons, or in the interests of the comfort of other passengers. Information about unacceptable items is available upon request.

8.4.3 We may refuse to accept Baggage for carriage unless it is in our reasonable opinion properly and securely packed in suitable containers. Information about packing and containers unacceptable to us is available upon request.

8.5 Right of Search

For reasons of safety and security we may request that you permit a search and scan of your person and a search, scan or x-ray of your Baggage. If you are not available, your Baggage may be searched in your absence for the purpose of determining whether you are in possession of or whether you’re Baggage contains any item described in Article 8.3.1 or any firearms, ammunition or weapons which have not been presented to us in accordance with Articles 8.3.2 or 8.3.3. If you are unwilling to comply with such request we may refuse to carry you and your Baggage. In the event a search or scan causes Damage to you, or an x-ray or scan causes damage to your Baggage, we shall not be liable for such Damage unless due to our fault or negligence.

mapped_evidence_text:
Baggage Conditions Rules

Baggage Conditions link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/conditions-of-carriage-baggage/

Article 8 Baggage

8.1 Free Baggage Allowance

You may carry some Baggage, free of charge, subject to our conditions and limitations, which are available on our website Baggage information (Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/ )

8.2 Excess Baggage

You will be required to pay a charge for carriage of Baggage in excess of the free Baggage allowance. To learn more about  the rates kindly reach out to us on +254711024747.

8.3 Items Unacceptable as Baggage

8.3.1 You must not include in your Baggage:

8.3.1.2 Items the carriage of which is prohibited by the applicable laws, regulations or orders of any state to be flown from or to;

8.3.1.3 Items which are reasonably considered by us to be unsuitable for carriage because they are dangerous or unsafe, or because of their weight, size, shape or character, or because they are fragile or perishable having regard to, among other things, the type of aircraft being used. Information about unacceptable items is available upon request.

8.3.2 Firearms and ammunition other than for hunting and sporting purposes are prohibited from carriage as Baggage. Firearms and ammunition for hunting and sporting purposes may be accepted as Checked Baggage. Firearms must be unloaded, with the safety catch on, and suitably packed. Carriage of ammunition is subject to ICAO and IATA regulations as specified in Article 8.3.1.1.

[List level 1] - Extra seats for stowage of items shall not be issued on the emergency exit row.

mapped_evidence_text:
my flight has been canceled/rescheduled. Does that mean I have been rebooked?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight. If you are happy with the new flight details highlighted on the email, click on “ACCEPT CHANGES”

However, if you would like to see more flight options, go to the Kenya Airways website and click on Manage my booking where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

If my outbound flight has been changed, can I also change the inbound flight free of charge?

No. With the self-rebooking tool, you will only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors. If you wish to change the inbound because you lost a day(s) on the outbound, you will have to reach out to your travel agent or our Contact center office.

If checked-in, will the bags be transferred automatically to the new flight?

Yes, they will be transferred automatically.

Does the tool rebook other airlines document with KQ sectors like DL or AF?

Yes, it does. However, instead of revalidation, the ticket will be reissued.

Does the tool rebook award tickets?

Yes, it does

What happens if a flight is disrupted more than once?

You can self-rebook once per every disruption.

1. Who Requires Medical Clearance to Fly?

If you have a pre-existing medical condition, we advise you visit your doctor before you fly, so that we can know how to best serve you.

You require a medical clearance to fly if you:

[List level 1] - Recently had a major medical incident (heart attack, heart failure, stroke and respiratory failure, recent pneumothorax, etc).

[List level 1] - Had surgery within the previous two weeks

[List level 1] - One has a pre-existing heart or respiratory condition

[List level 1] - Have a medical condition which may be adversely affected by flying

[List level 1] - Have thrombophlebitis or history of pulmonary embolism

[List level 1] - Have unstable mental illness/impairment

[List level 1] - You are unable to care for yourself hence needs special assistance

[List level 1] - If you cannot use a normal upright seat e.g. a stretcher or medical condition that necessitates extra legroom

[List level 1] - Need in-flight oxygen, a portable oxygen concentrator (POC) or ventilator

[List level 1] - Need battery-powered* medical equipment (except for CPAP) or a medical procedure during the flight

If you have any of the above or other medical conditions, download and complete the MEDIF (Medical Information Form for Fitness to Fly) at least 24 hours before travel is due to commence and submit to doctors.kq@kenya-airways.com or our 24-hour Contact Centre Tel: +254 734 104 747, Mobile: +254 711 024 747 or WhatsApp: +254 705 474 747 for assistance.

2. Passenger Medical Clearance Services Process

money, buy airtime, pay bills, pay for goods and services from their mobile phones. Once the guest opts to make a payment via Tigo pesa, the e-ticket is sent to their email address.

Other Methods of Payment (AMOPs)

Mobile Banking or Bank Transfer

This form of payment is currently available in the Kenya, Nigeria and a few selected African countries. It is a real time 24-hour digital payment solution that allows for bank-to-bank transfers at a low cost. it is easy to use, fast, convenient, secure and affordable. This option is available for online banking, mobile apps, and USSD mobile banking.

Cash Payment

You can pay by cash after you have made your online booking. You then pay and retrieve your ticket at a Kenya Airways ticket office. Important to note: there is usually a fee charged for cash payments. If you wish to pay at the ticket office, make sure to bring along the booking confirmation or booking code that you received by e-mail. Please note: Not all ticket offices accept cash payments.

Online banking, also known as ‘Real Time Online Banking’ (RTOB), allows you to shop and pay online safely and easily. Payment services include the below:

PayPal

We accept PayPal as one of the convenient online payment methods. Customers with a PayPal account can make payments on our website and confirm their ticket payment securely. Once the payment confirmation is received, we will issue the electronic ticket to the customer via email.

China Union Pay

criteria.criterion: If part of the ticket has been used in an involuntary refund case, the amount is at least the difference between the fare paid and the applicable fare for the portion used.
anchors: not less than the difference between the fare paid
mapped_evidence_text:
and the Ticket indicates that there is a restriction on refund, we shall make a refund only to the person who paid for the Ticket, or to that person's order.

10.1.3 Refunds will only be made Subject to the ticket rules.

10.2 INVOLUNTARY REFUNDS

10.2.1 If we cancel a flight, fail to operate a flight reasonably according to schedule, fail to stop at your destination or Stopover, or cause you to miss a connecting flight on which you hold a reservation, the amount of the refund shall be:

10.2.1.1 if no portion of the Ticket has been used, an amount equal to the fare paid;

10.2.1.2 if a portion of the Ticket has been used, not less than the difference between the fare paid and the applicable fare for travel between the points for which the Ticket has been used.

10.3 VOLUNTARY REFUNDS

10.3.1 If you are entitled to a refund of your Ticket for reasons other than those set out in Article 10.2, the amount of the refund shall be:

10.3.1.1 if no portion of the Ticket has been used, an amount equal to the fare paid, less any reasonable service charges or cancellation fees;

10.3.1.2 if a portion of the Ticket has been used, the refund will be an amount equal to the difference between the fare paid and the applicable fare for travel between the points for which the Ticket has been used, less any reasonable service charges or cancellation fees.

10.4 RIGHT TO REFUSE REFUND

10.4.1 We may refuse a refund where application is made after the expiry of the validity of the Ticket.

Security Removed Items

These are items taken at a security check from a guest or from his/her hand baggage because they are not allowed to be carried at all as these items are classified as weapons or Dangerous Goods.

Some items can only be accepted as checked baggage (sharp, pointed, blunt objects, tools or any toys imitating one of these items).

in Article 9.2.2, except as otherwise provided by the Convention, the options outlined in Article 9.2.2.1 to 9.2.2.3 are the sole and exclusive remedies available to you and we shall have no further liability to you.

9.3 DENIED BOARDING COMPENSATION

If we are unable to provide previously confirmed space, we shall provide compensation to those Passengers denied boarding in accordance with applicable law and our denied boarding compensation policy. A copy of our denied boarding compensation policy is available upon request. Eligibility for denied boarding compensation is conditional on passengers having complied with check-in and boarding deadlines. Compensation may include monetary reimbursement, alternate transportation on another carrier, or downgrade refund, in accordance with applicable law and our denied boarding compensation policy.

ARTICLE 10: REFUNDS

10.1 We will refund a Ticket or any unused portion, in accordance with the applicable fare rules or Tariff, as follows:

10.1.1 Except as otherwise provided in this Article, we shall be entitled to make a refund either to the person named in the Ticket or to the person who has paid for the Ticket, upon presentation of satisfactory proof of such payment.

10.1.2 If a Ticket has been paid for by a person other than the Passenger named in the Ticket, and the Ticket indicates that there is a restriction on refund, we shall make a refund only to the person who paid for the Ticket, or to that person's order.

10.1.3 Refunds will only be made Subject to the ticket rules.

10.2 INVOLUNTARY REFUNDS

and the Ticket indicates that there is a restriction on refund, we shall make a refund only to the person who paid for the Ticket, or to that person's order.

10.1.3 Refunds will only be made Subject to the ticket rules.

10.2 INVOLUNTARY REFUNDS

10.2.1 If we cancel a flight, fail to operate a flight reasonably according to schedule, fail to stop at your destination or Stopover, or cause you to miss a connecting flight on which you hold a reservation, the amount of the refund shall be:

10.2.1.1 if no portion of the Ticket has been used, an amount equal to the fare paid;

10.2.1.2 if a portion of the Ticket has been used, not less than the difference between the fare paid and the applicable fare for travel between the points for which the Ticket has been used.

10.3 VOLUNTARY REFUNDS

10.3.1 If you are entitled to a refund of your Ticket for reasons other than those set out in Article 10.2, the amount of the refund shall be:

10.3.1.1 if no portion of the Ticket has been used, an amount equal to the fare paid, less any reasonable service charges or cancellation fees;

10.3.1.2 if a portion of the Ticket has been used, the refund will be an amount equal to the difference between the fare paid and the applicable fare for travel between the points for which the Ticket has been used, less any reasonable service charges or cancellation fees.

10.4 RIGHT TO REFUSE REFUND

10.4.1 We may refuse a refund where application is made after the expiry of the validity of the Ticket.

criteria.criterion: The self-rebooking tool only changes disrupted sectors free of charge.
anchors: only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors
mapped_evidence_text:
my flight has been canceled/rescheduled. Does that mean I have been rebooked?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight. If you are happy with the new flight details highlighted on the email, click on “ACCEPT CHANGES”

However, if you would like to see more flight options, go to the Kenya Airways website and click on Manage my booking where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

If my outbound flight has been changed, can I also change the inbound flight free of charge?

No. With the self-rebooking tool, you will only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors. If you wish to change the inbound because you lost a day(s) on the outbound, you will have to reach out to your travel agent or our Contact center office.

If checked-in, will the bags be transferred automatically to the new flight?

Yes, they will be transferred automatically.

Does the tool rebook other airlines document with KQ sectors like DL or AF?

Yes, it does. However, instead of revalidation, the ticket will be reissued.

Does the tool rebook award tickets?

Yes, it does

What happens if a flight is disrupted more than once?

You can self-rebook once per every disruption.

Baggage Restrictions

Prohibited Items

For the safety of our passengers and aircraft, passengers are prohibited from carrying the following items in either checked or hand baggage:

[List level 1] - Explosives, munitions, fireworks, and flares

[List level 1] - Flammable liquids such as paints and adhesives

[List level 1] - Corrosive materials such as mercury (which may be contained in thermometers or blood pressure gauges,) acids, alkalis, and wet cell batteries

Do I need to call Kenya Airways to reconfirm my flight?

If your booking is successful, there is no need to call us. You can check in online or at the airport on the day of departure.

What is an Extra Legroom Seat?

The extra Legroom Seats are located in Economy Class exit rows with a generous space for you to stretch out. It is offered only on Kenya Airways-operated flights and is not available on flights operated by our partner airlines.

Extra Legroom Seats are subject to availability, terms & conditions, and other eligibility requirements. Please view all requirements before making your purchase to ensure you meet all of the criteria.

Who can book an Extra Legroom Seat?

Below is a summary of the eligibility requirements.

Guest must:

[List level 1] - Be physically able to reach, locate and operate the emergency exit window or door, and to quickly pass through the exit.

[List level 1] - Be able to understand and acknowledge instructions in English.

[List level 1] - Be aged 18 years or older and not have any conditions.

[List level 1] - Not be travelling with children or infants, a care giver, a guide dog or an assistance animal.

[List level 1] - Not be in any stage of pregnancy

[List level 1] - How do I book an Extra Legroom Seat?

If you meet the exit row seat safety requirements, we strongly recommend you to book early as seats are available on a first-come, first-served basis.

Security Removed Items

criteria.criterion: If part of the ticket has been used in an involuntary refund case, the amount is at least the difference between the fare paid and the applicable fare for the portion used.
anchors: not less than the difference between the fare paid
mapped_evidence_text:
and the Ticket indicates that there is a restriction on refund, we shall make a refund only to the person who paid for the Ticket, or to that person's order.

10.1.3 Refunds will only be made Subject to the ticket rules.

10.2 INVOLUNTARY REFUNDS

10.2.1 If we cancel a flight, fail to operate a flight reasonably according to schedule, fail to stop at your destination or Stopover, or cause you to miss a connecting flight on which you hold a reservation, the amount of the refund shall be:

10.2.1.1 if no portion of the Ticket has been used, an amount equal to the fare paid;

10.2.1.2 if a portion of the Ticket has been used, not less than the difference between the fare paid and the applicable fare for travel between the points for which the Ticket has been used.

10.3 VOLUNTARY REFUNDS

10.3.1 If you are entitled to a refund of your Ticket for reasons other than those set out in Article 10.2, the amount of the refund shall be:

10.3.1.1 if no portion of the Ticket has been used, an amount equal to the fare paid, less any reasonable service charges or cancellation fees;

10.3.1.2 if a portion of the Ticket has been used, the refund will be an amount equal to the difference between the fare paid and the applicable fare for travel between the points for which the Ticket has been used, less any reasonable service charges or cancellation fees.

10.4 RIGHT TO REFUSE REFUND

10.4.1 We may refuse a refund where application is made after the expiry of the validity of the Ticket.

criteria.criterion: A trained service dog may travel in the cabin without a kennel if properly harnessed.
anchors: properly harnessed and do not occupy a seat
mapped_evidence_text:
Pet Carriage

Pet Carriage website link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/pet-carriage/

Live animals will not be accepted as checked-in Animal in Hold (AVIH) or Pet in Cabin (PETC) on Kenya Airways flights.

Live animals shall be consigned as cargo only.

Exception

Service Dog

Service dog shall be accepted in the cabin if it’s providing assistance to a person with disability i.e. Blind guest, a person with mental or psychiatric disorder. The dog is certified and individually trained to provide assistance to a person with a disability.

For more information on health and import documents needed to transport a service dog, contact KQ Cargo for guidance.

Note: All service dogs must be trained to be accepted. Emotional support dogs are no longer considered as service animals.

Passengers with physical, sensory, psychiatric, intellectual, or other mental disabilities who need to travel with a service dog may be required to present certain documentation from a licensed medical health professional that is treating the passenger, dated within one year, stating that the service dog is necessary for the passenger/s mental health or treatment during air travel and/or any activity at the passengers’ destination.

Service Dogs are:

[List level 1] - Accepted free of charge.

[List level 1] - They can be accepted in the cabin without a kennel/cage provided they are properly harnessed and do not occupy a seat.

and/or any activity at the passengers’ destination.

Service Dogs are:

[List level 1] - Accepted free of charge.

[List level 1] - They can be accepted in the cabin without a kennel/cage provided they are properly harnessed and do not occupy a seat.

[List level 1] - Service dogs are trained to behave properly. An animal that shows disruptive behavior cannot be accepted as a guide animal even if it performs assistive function for the guest.

[List level 1] - On a flight segment which is 8 hours or more, ask the guest to provide documentation that the animal will not need to relieve itself during the flight or if the guest has in possession any items for the animal (e.g. nappies, medicine) to avoid any health or sanitation issue on the flight. If this is not the case, the guide dog cannot be accepted.

[List level 1] - Passengers with service dogs can be accepted on any seat in the cabin except exit rows.

[List level 1] - The animal shall sit at the feet of the passenger seat (or at the feet/floor of the adjacent seat , if it is not occupied)

[List level 1] - The service dog shall not obstruct the aisle.

[List level 1] - Advanced reservation is required, PNR “ESAN’

[List level 1] - The information is also made available in the PIL in order to inform the crew.

Transportation of Dogs to USA

mapped_evidence_text:
Baggage Restrictions

Link to Baggage Restrictions website page: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/baggage-restrictions/

Please ensure that you do not pack items specified in this list in your carry-on or checked baggage.

Medically necessary needles and syringes are exempt from these prohibitions if passengers have in their possession prescription medication with a professionally printed label that identifies the medical office, pharmacy, or manufacturer of the medication.

Prohibited Items

For the safety of our passengers and aircraft, passengers are prohibited from carrying the following items in either checked or hand baggage:

[List level 1] - Explosives, munitions, fireworks, and flares

criteria.criterion: Yes, the disruption self-rebooking tool supports award tickets.

mapped_evidence_text:
my flight has been canceled/rescheduled. Does that mean I have been rebooked?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight. If you are happy with the new flight details highlighted on the email, click on “ACCEPT CHANGES”

However, if you would like to see more flight options, go to the Kenya Airways website and click on Manage my booking where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

If my outbound flight has been changed, can I also change the inbound flight free of charge?

No. With the self-rebooking tool, you will only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors. If you wish to change the inbound because you lost a day(s) on the outbound, you will have to reach out to your travel agent or our Contact center office.

If checked-in, will the bags be transferred automatically to the new flight?

Yes, they will be transferred automatically.

Does the tool rebook other airlines document with KQ sectors like DL or AF?

Yes, it does. However, instead of revalidation, the ticket will be reissued.

Does the tool rebook award tickets?

Yes, it does

What happens if a flight is disrupted more than once?

You can self-rebook once per every disruption.

Where do I find the flight options available for rebooking?

Once you log in, you will be redirected to a page that has all available flight options and timings.

*Flight timings available for rebooking are either less than 24 hours from your original flight or 7 days after.

Can I rebook a flight that hasn’t been disrupted?

No. Only flights with a schedule change i.e. delayed or canceled are open for self-rebooking.

What happens if I do not rebook myself/are not able to rebook?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight, after which you will receive an email with your new flight details.

Will I receive my e-ticket and boarding pass?

Yes, after you have selected and confirmed your new flight, you will receive an email confirmation as well as your e-ticket.

I have received an email that my flight has been canceled/rescheduled. Does that mean I have been rebooked?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight. If you are happy with the new flight details highlighted on the email, click on “ACCEPT CHANGES”

However, if you would like to see more flight options, go to the Kenya Airways website and click on Manage my booking where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

baggage (e.g. Spillable liquid) shall not be accepted for check-in.

Medicines:

Kenya Airways has no restrictions on the carriage of medicines except when the medicine is classified as Dangerous Goods such as:

[List level 1] - An inflammable liquid

[List level 1] - Toxic, infectious or radioactive material

[List level 1] - A gas

Helium Balloons:

Although Helium is not considered as Dangerous Goods, the transportation of balloons filled up with Helium is forbidden because they can explode onboard.

Lithium Batteries:

Lithium batteries can generate a great amount of heat if short circuited, or may catch fire if damaged, improperly designed or improperly assembled. Spare batteries must be individually protected to prevent short circuits by placement in the original retail packaging or by otherwise insulating terminals, e.g. by taping over exposed terminals or placing each battery in a separate plastic bag or protective pouch and carried in carry-on baggage only.

Articles containing lithium cells or batteries, the primary purpose of which is to provide power to another device, e.g. power banks, are considered as spare batteries and are restricted to carry-on baggage only.

NOTE: Baggage equipped with a lithium battery, other than lithium button cells:

[List level 1] - If the baggage is to be checked in, the lithium battery must be removed from the baggage and the lithium battery must be carried in the cabin; or

[List level 1] - The baggage must be carried in the cabin.

[List level 1] - Baggage where the lithium battery is designed to charge other devices and cannot be removed is forbidden for carriage.

Human Remains

"UNCHECKED BAGGAGE" means any of your Baggage other than Checked Baggage.

ARTICLE 2 APPLICABILITY

2.1 GENERAL Except as provided in Articles 2.2 , 2.4 and 2.5, our Conditions of Carriage apply only to those flights, or flight segments, where our name or Airline Designator Code is indicated in the carrier box of the Ticket for that flight or flight segment.

2.2 CHARTER OPERATIONS If carriage is performed pursuant to a charter agreement, these Conditions of Carriage apply only to the extent they are incorporated, by reference or otherwise, in the charter agreement or the Ticket.

2.3 CODE SHARES On some services we may have arrangements with other carriers known as "Code Shares". This means that even if you have a reservation with us and hold a ticket where our name or airline designator code is indicated as the carrier, another carrier may operate the aircraft. If such arrangements apply, we will advise you of the carrier operating the aircraft at the time you make a reservation. In such cases, the Conditions of Carriage of the operating carrier will govern all operational and service-related matters (including boarding, in-flight service, delays, and baggage handling), while our Conditions of Carriage will govern contractual matters such as ticketing, refunds, and liability.

where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

If my outbound flight has been changed, can I also change the inbound flight free of charge?

No. With the self-rebooking tool, you will only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors. If you wish to change the inbound because you lost a day(s) on the outbound, you will have to reach out to your travel agent or our Contact center office.

If checked-in, will the bags be transferred automatically to the new flight?

Yes, they will be transferred automatically.

Does the tool rebook other airlines document with KQ sectors like DL or AF?

Yes, it does. However, instead of revalidation, the ticket will be reissued.

Does the tool rebook award tickets?

Yes, it does

What happens if a flight is disrupted more than once?

You can self-rebook once per every disruption.

a proof of payment?

Your ticket states details about the fare and taxes paid for your flight. It is your proof of payment and will be widely accepted as a receipt.

After booking your flight on Kenya-airways.com you will receive your ticket via e-mail as soon as we have received the payment.

Can I pay for a ticket for another person travelling from abroad?

Yes, you can book for another person travelling from abroad. However, if you choose to pay with credit or debit cards you may be required to present the card used for booking, it must be presented while checking into your flight at the commencement of travel. If you, as the credit card holder, are not travelling, a copy of the credit card with an authorization signed by yourself should be presented at check-in. alternatively, the card or a copy of the card with your signed authorization can be presented to the nearest Kenya airways ticketing office at least 72 hours before the flight. This verification is required to ensure a smooth check-in process at the airport and to avoid being refused carriage. Failure to comply will result in the requirement to pay the full ticket cost at the airport or refusal of carriage.

No, one has to call our Contact center for Assistance.

When one is a no show can they make any changes to their booking online?

No this is not possible, one has to call our contact center for Assistance.

What happens to bookings that have been cancelled?

One cannot access any bookings that have been cancelled online.

Online Refunds

Online refunds web page: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/book-manage/manage-booking/online-refunds/

You may be eligible for a refund on unused or partially unused Kenya Airways tickets, depending on the type of ticket you purchased:

Taxes, Fees and Charges:

[List level 1] - Applicable taxes, fees and charges imposed by government or other authority, or by the operator of an airport, shall be payable by you. At the time you purchase your Ticket, you will be advised of taxes, fees and charges not included in the fare, most of which will normally be shown separately on the Ticket.

The taxes, fees and charges imposed on air travel are constantly changing and can be imposed after the date of Ticket issuance. If there is an increase in a tax, fee or charge shown on the Ticket, you will be obliged to pay it. Likewise, if a new tax, fee or charge is imposed even after Ticket issuance, you will be obliged to pay it. Similarly, in the event any taxes, fees or charges which you have paid to us at the time of Ticket issuance are abolished or reduced such that they no longer apply to you, or a lesser amount is due, you will be entitled to claim a refund.

In addition should the Passenger not travel on a flight and they are holding a refundable or a non refundable ticket they are equally to benefit from a refund of said applicable taxes, charges and other fees.

[List level 1] - For tickets bought on kenya-airways.com (Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/ ) you may be eligible to apply for a refund using the refund widget. If your inbound travel is in the future and your booking is still active.

If, in our reasonable opinion, you conduct yourself aboard the aircraft so as to endanger the aircraft or any person or property on board, or obstruct the crew in the performance of their duties, or fail to comply with any instructions of the crew, including but not limited to those with respect to smoking, alcohol or drug consumption, or behave in a manner which causes discomfort, inconvenience, damage or injury to other passengers or the crew, including but not limited to harassment, threats, or hoax threats, we may take such measures as we deem reasonably necessary to prevent continuation of such conduct, including restraint. criteria.criterion: Where the Montreal Convention applies, the stated baggage liability limit is 1,519 Special Drawing Rights (SDR) per passenger or the applicable revised Convention amount, subject to the stated exceptions.
anchors: 1,519 Special Drawing Rights per Passenger
mapped_evidence_text:
Except in the case of an act or omission done with intent to cause damage or recklessly and with knowledge that damage would probably result, or where you have made a special declaration of interest and paid any fee required by us, our liability in the case of destruction, loss, damage or delay of Baggage shall be limited as provided by the Convention, ie:

15.5.2.1 where the Warsaw Convention applies, the applicable limit is normally taken to be 17 Special Drawing Rights per kilo for checked Baggage and 332 Special Drawing Rights in the case of unchecked Baggage, provided that if in accordance with applicable law different limits of liability are applicable such different limits shall apply. If the weight of your checked Baggage is not recorded on the baggage check, it is presumed that the total weight of the checked Baggage does not exceed the applicable free baggage allowance for the class of carriage concerned;

15.5.2.2 where the Montreal Convention applies, the applicable limit is 1,519 Special Drawing Rights per Passenger (or any such sum as provided under Article 22 paragraph 2 of the Montreal Convention).

15.5.3 We are not liable for any damage caused by your Baggage. You shall be responsible for any damage caused by your Baggage to other persons or property, including our property.

15.5.4  We shall have no liability whatsoever for damage to articles not permitted to be contained in checked Baggage under Article 8.3, including fragile or perishable items, items having a special value, such as money, jewelry, precious metals, computers, personal electronic devices, negotiable papers, securities, or other valuables, business documents, passports and other identification documents, or samples.

Service Dog

criteria.criterion: If automatic rebooking is acceptable, select Accept Changes.
anchors: DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES
mapped_evidence_text:
to rebook my flight?

Simply visit the Kenya Airways website(Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/ ), select “Manage Booking”

You will find the rebooking link at the top marked “Click here.

Where do I find the flight options available for rebooking?

Once you log in, you will be redirected to a page that has all available flight options and timings.

*Flight timings available for rebooking are either less than 24 hours from your original flight or 7 days after.

Can I rebook a flight that hasn’t been disrupted?

No. Only flights with a schedule change i.e. delayed or canceled are open for self-rebooking.

What happens if I do not rebook myself/are not able to rebook?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight, after which you will receive an email with your new flight details.

Will I receive my e-ticket and boarding pass?

Yes, after you have selected and confirmed your new flight, you will receive an email confirmation as well as your e-ticket.

I have received an email that my flight has been canceled/rescheduled. Does that mean I have been rebooked?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight. If you are happy with the new flight details highlighted on the email, click on “ACCEPT CHANGES”

However, if you would like to see more flight options, go to the Kenya Airways website and click on Manage my booking where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

If my outbound flight has been changed, can I also change the inbound flight free of charge?

No. With the self-rebooking tool, you will only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors. If you wish to change the inbound because you lost a day(s) on the outbound, you will have to reach out to your travel agent or our Contact center office.

If checked-in, will the bags be transferred automatically to the new flight?

Yes, they will be transferred automatically.

Does the tool rebook other airlines document with KQ sectors like DL or AF?

Yes, it does. However, instead of revalidation, the ticket will be reissued.

Does the tool rebook award tickets?

Yes, it does

What happens if a flight is disrupted more than once?

You can self-rebook once per every disruption.

mapped_evidence_text:
Online Refunds

Online refunds web page: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/book-manage/manage-booking/online-refunds/

You may be eligible for a refund on unused or partially unused Kenya Airways tickets, depending on the type of ticket you purchased:

Taxes, Fees and Charges:

[List level 1] - Applicable taxes, fees and charges imposed by government or other authority, or by the operator of an airport, shall be payable by you. At the time you purchase your Ticket, you will be advised of taxes, fees and charges not included in the fare, most of which will normally be shown separately on the Ticket.

The taxes, fees and charges imposed on air travel are constantly changing and can be imposed after the date of Ticket issuance. If there is an increase in a tax, fee or charge shown on the Ticket, you will be obliged to pay it. Likewise, if a new tax, fee or charge is imposed even after Ticket issuance, you will be obliged to pay it. Similarly, in the event any taxes, fees or charges which you have paid to us at the time of Ticket issuance are abolished or reduced such that they no longer apply to you, or a lesser amount is due, you will be entitled to claim a refund.

In addition should the Passenger not travel on a flight and they are holding a refundable or a non refundable ticket they are equally to benefit from a refund of said applicable taxes, charges and other fees.

[List level 1] - For tickets bought on kenya-airways.com (Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/ ) you may be eligible to apply for a refund using the refund widget. If your inbound travel is in the future and your booking is still active.

a non refundable ticket they are equally to benefit from a refund of said applicable taxes, charges and other fees.

[List level 1] - For tickets bought on kenya-airways.com (Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/ ) you may be eligible to apply for a refund using the refund widget. If your inbound travel is in the future and your booking is still active.

[List level 1] - When you are in Modify My Booking, select ‘Cancel and refund’. Please be aware that if your ticket is open, all sectors will be cancelled. Choosing to Refund will cancel the whole ticket and all flights.

[List level 1] - For tickets bought on Kenya-airways.com and the inbound travel has a past date or cancelled, complete the Refund form here (Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/book-manage/manage-booking/request-for-your-refund/ ). Please note once you’ve submitted this form, your entire booking will be cancelled.

[List level 1] - The refund can only be credited to the form of payment used to make the purchase. Refunds are issued in accordance with fare conditions.

[List level 1] - For tickets bought from a preferred travel agent, please contact the agent directly to arrange your booking cancellation and refund.

[List level 1] - For tickets bought from our ticketing office and contact center, please visit any of our sales office or call the contact center directly to arrange your booking cancellation and refund.

Refund Processing Times:

[List level 1] - Kenya Airways will issue refunds for eligible tickets within 21-30 business days for credit/debit card purchases, but please note that this does not include your own bank processing time.

criteria.criterion: Asante Gold and Platinum travellers flying from Nairobi receive priority check-in and boarding.
anchors: access to the lounge with one guest
mapped_evidence_text:
preferred seat. Once completed, you can print your boarding pass at your convenience. When you arrive at the airport, use the designated online check-in drop-off point for your luggage and then proceed to the boarding gate. Kenya Airways has taken online check-in to new heights, providing a smoother and more convenient experience.

International Check-in:

For international flights, it is mandatory for all passengers to complete the check-in process a minimum of two and a half hours before the flight's departure, regardless of the travel class. The check-in counters close precisely one hour before the scheduled departure time.

Domestic Check-in:

Passengers traveling on domestic flights must present a valid form of identification during check-in. It is required to complete the check-in process at least one and a half hours prior to departure, regardless of the travel class. The check-in counters close half an hour before takeoff.

Check-in from China Guangzhou:

Passengers departing from China Guangzhou are advised to note that the check-in counters in this location will be closed an hour and a half (90 minutes) before the scheduled flight departure.

Priority Check-in:

Travelers who hold Asante Rewards Elite status (Gold and Platinum levels) and are flying from Nairobi to any destination can enjoy the privileges of priority check-in and boarding. This also includes access to the lounge with one guest. Always remember to present your Asante Rewards card at the counter to automatically register your earned miles. If you possess sufficient miles, request an upgrade to experience the services of our business class.

made your online booking. You then pay and retrieve your ticket at a Kenya Airways ticket office. Important to note: there is usually a fee charged for cash payments. If you wish to pay at the ticket office, make sure to bring along the booking confirmation or booking code that you received by e-mail. Please note: Not all ticket offices accept cash payments.

Online banking, also known as ‘Real Time Online Banking’ (RTOB), allows you to shop and pay online safely and easily. Payment services include the below:

PayPal

We accept PayPal as one of the convenient online payment methods. Customers with a PayPal account can make payments on our website and confirm their ticket payment securely. Once the payment confirmation is received, we will issue the electronic ticket to the customer via email.

China Union Pay

China Union Pay or by its abbreviation, CUP or UPI internationally, is a Chinese state-owned financial services corporation headquartered in Shanghai, China. It provides bank card services and a major card scheme in mainland China. Enter all necessary details and confirm your booking. Once your payment has been authorized, you will be sent an e-ticket and payment confirmation by e-mail.

Alipay

Alipay is a third-party mobile and online payment platform headquartered in Shanghai, China. It operates as a digital wallet offering Mobile payments via QR codes (scan to pay) and peer-to-peer transfer.

Once your payment has been authorized, you will be sent an e-ticket and payment confirmation by e-mail.

WeChat Pay

WeChat Pay is the mobile payment and digital wallet service in China which allows you to make payments by scanning QR code.

Once your payment has been authorized, you will be sent an e-ticket and payment confirmation by e-mail.

iDEAL

made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

Equitel

Equitel is a mobile payment option from Kenya. Once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

Vodacom Mpesa

This is Vodacom mpesa is a mobile money transfer service in Tanzania. Once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

MTN Mobile Money

MTN Mobile money is a secure mobile money wallet used to store funds, send and receive money. Guests can pay for their tickets though this mobile money option and once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

Tigo Pesa

This mobile money payment option is available in Tanzania. Tigo Pesa allows customers to send and receive money, buy airtime, pay bills, pay for goods and services from their mobile phones. Once the guest opts to make a payment via Tigo pesa, the e-ticket is sent to their email address.

Other Methods of Payment (AMOPs)

Mobile Banking or Bank Transfer

This form of payment is currently available in the Kenya, Nigeria and a few selected African countries. It is a real time 24-hour digital payment solution that allows for bank-to-bank transfers at a low cost. it is easy to use, fast, convenient, secure and affordable. This option is available for online banking, mobile apps, and USSD mobile banking.

Cash Payment

You can pay by cash after you have made your online booking. You then pay and retrieve your ticket at a Kenya Airways ticket office. Important to note: there is usually a fee charged for cash payments. If you wish to pay at the ticket office, make sure to bring along the booking confirmation or booking code that you received by e-mail. Please note: Not all ticket offices accept cash payments.

where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

If my outbound flight has been changed, can I also change the inbound flight free of charge?

No. With the self-rebooking tool, you will only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors. If you wish to change the inbound because you lost a day(s) on the outbound, you will have to reach out to your travel agent or our Contact center office.

If checked-in, will the bags be transferred automatically to the new flight?

Yes, they will be transferred automatically.

Does the tool rebook other airlines document with KQ sectors like DL or AF?

Yes, it does. However, instead of revalidation, the ticket will be reissued.

Does the tool rebook award tickets?

Yes, it does

What happens if a flight is disrupted more than once?

You can self-rebook once per every disruption.

If we are unable to provide previously confirmed space, we shall provide compensation to those Passengers denied boarding in accordance with applicable law and our denied boarding compensation policy. 10.1.3 Refunds will only be made Subject to the ticket rules.

made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

Equitel

Equitel is a mobile payment option from Kenya. Once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

Vodacom Mpesa

This is Vodacom mpesa is a mobile money transfer service in Tanzania. Once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

MTN Mobile Money

MTN Mobile money is a secure mobile money wallet used to store funds, send and receive money. Guests can pay for their tickets though this mobile money option and once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

Tigo Pesa

This mobile money payment option is available in Tanzania. Tigo Pesa allows customers to send and receive money, buy airtime, pay bills, pay for goods and services from their mobile phones. Once the guest opts to make a payment via Tigo pesa, the e-ticket is sent to their email address.

Other Methods of Payment (AMOPs)

Mobile Banking or Bank Transfer

This form of payment is currently available in the Kenya, Nigeria and a few selected African countries. It is a real time 24-hour digital payment solution that allows for bank-to-bank transfers at a low cost. it is easy to use, fast, convenient, secure and affordable. This option is available for online banking, mobile apps, and USSD mobile banking.

Cash Payment

You can pay by cash after you have made your online booking. You then pay and retrieve your ticket at a Kenya Airways ticket office. Important to note: there is usually a fee charged for cash payments. If you wish to pay at the ticket office, make sure to bring along the booking confirmation or booking code that you received by e-mail. Please note: Not all ticket offices accept cash payments.
