criteria.criterion: Already checked-in bags are transferred automatically to the new flight under the self-rebooking policy.
anchors: they will be transferred automatically
mapped_evidence_text:
However, if you would like to see more flight options, go to the Kenya Airways website and click on Manage my booking where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

If my outbound flight has been changed, can I also change the inbound flight free of charge?

No. With the self-rebooking tool, you will only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors. If you wish to change the inbound because you lost a day(s) on the outbound, you will have to reach out to your travel agent or our Contact center office.

If checked-in, will the bags be transferred automatically to the new flight?

Yes, they will be transferred automatically.

Does the tool rebook other airlines document with KQ sectors like DL or AF?

Yes, it does. However, instead of revalidation, the ticket will be reissued.

Does the tool rebook award tickets?

Yes, it does

What happens if a flight is disrupted more than once?

You can self-rebook once per every disruption.

criteria.criterion: The operating carrier governs operational and service matters such as boarding and baggage handling.
anchors: Conditions of Carriage of the operating carrier
mapped_evidence_text:
"STOPOVER" means a scheduled stop on your journey, at a point between the place of departure and the place of destination.

"TARIFF" means the published fares, charges and/or related conditions of carriage of an airline filed, where required, with the appropriate authorities.

"TICKET" means either the document entitled "Passenger Ticket and Baggage Check" or the Electronic Ticket, in each case issued by us or on our behalf, and includes the Conditions of Contract, notices and Coupons.

"UNCHECKED BAGGAGE" means any of your Baggage other than Checked Baggage.

ARTICLE 2 APPLICABILITY

2.1 GENERAL Except as provided in Articles 2.2 , 2.4 and 2.5, our Conditions of Carriage apply only to those flights, or flight segments, where our name or Airline Designator Code is indicated in the carrier box of the Ticket for that flight or flight segment.

2.2 CHARTER OPERATIONS If carriage is performed pursuant to a charter agreement, these Conditions of Carriage apply only to the extent they are incorporated, by reference or otherwise, in the charter agreement or the Ticket.

2.3 CODE SHARES On some services we may have arrangements with other carriers known as "Code Shares". This means that even if you have a reservation with us and hold a ticket where our name or airline designator code is indicated as the carrier, another carrier may operate the aircraft. If such arrangements apply, we will advise you of the carrier operating the aircraft at the time you make a reservation. In such cases, the Conditions of Carriage of the operating carrier will govern all operational and service-related matters (including boarding, in-flight service, delays, and baggage handling), while our Conditions of Carriage will govern contractual matters such as ticketing, refunds, and liability.

Other Methods of Payment (AMOPs)

Mobile Banking or Bank Transfer

This form of payment is currently available in the Kenya, Nigeria and a few selected African countries. It is a real time 24-hour digital payment solution that allows for bank-to-bank transfers at a low cost. it is easy to use, fast, convenient, secure and affordable. This option is available for online banking, mobile apps, and USSD mobile banking.

Cash Payment

You can pay by cash after you have made your online booking. You then pay and retrieve your ticket at a Kenya Airways ticket office. Important to note: there is usually a fee charged for cash payments. If you wish to pay at the ticket office, make sure to bring along the booking confirmation or booking code that you received by e-mail. Please note: Not all ticket offices accept cash payments.

Online banking, also known as ‘Real Time Online Banking’ (RTOB), allows you to shop and pay online safely and easily. Payment services include the below:

PayPal

We accept PayPal as one of the convenient online payment methods. Customers with a PayPal account can make payments on our website and confirm their ticket payment securely. Once the payment confirmation is received, we will issue the electronic ticket to the customer via email.

China Union Pay

China Union Pay or by its abbreviation, CUP or UPI internationally, is a Chinese state-owned financial services corporation headquartered in Shanghai, China. It provides bank card services and a major card scheme in mainland China. Enter all necessary details and confirm your booking. Once your payment has been authorized, you will be sent an e-ticket and payment confirmation by e-mail.

Alipay

mapped_evidence_text:
8.6.3 Checked Baggage will, whenever possible, be carried on the same aircraft as you, unless we decide for safety, security or operational reasons to carry it on an alternative flight. If your Checked Baggage is carried on a subsequent flight we will deliver it to you, unless applicable law requires you to be present for customs clearance.

8.7 Unchecked Baggage

8.7.1 We may specify maximum dimensions and/or weight for Baggage which you carry on to the aircraft. If we have not done so, Baggage which you carry onto the aircraft must fit under the seat in front of you or in an enclosed storage compartment in the cabin of the aircraft. If your Baggage cannot be stored in this manner, or is of excessive weight, or is considered unsafe for any reason, it must be carried as Checked Baggage, subject to Articles 8.2 and 8.3.

8.7.2 Objects not suitable for carriage in the cargo compartment (such as delicate musical instruments), and which do not meet the requirements in Article 8.7.1 above, will only be accepted for carriage in the cabin compartment if you have given us notice in advance and permission has been granted by us. You may be required to pay a separate charge for this service.

8.8 Collection and Delivery of Checked Baggage

8.8.1 Subject to Article 8.6.3, you are required to collect your Checked Baggage as soon as it is made available at your destination or Stopover. Should you not collect it within a reasonable time, we may charge you a storage fee. Should your Checked Baggage not be claimed within three (3) months of the time it is made available, we may dispose of it without any liability to you.

8.8.2 Only the bearer of the Baggage Check and Baggage Identification Tag is entitled to delivery of the Checked Baggage.

However, if you would like to see more flight options, go to the Kenya Airways website and click on Manage my booking where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

If my outbound flight has been changed, can I also change the inbound flight free of charge?

No. With the self-rebooking tool, you will only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors. If you wish to change the inbound because you lost a day(s) on the outbound, you will have to reach out to your travel agent or our Contact center office.

If checked-in, will the bags be transferred automatically to the new flight?

Yes, they will be transferred automatically.

Does the tool rebook other airlines document with KQ sectors like DL or AF?

Yes, it does. However, instead of revalidation, the ticket will be reissued.

Does the tool rebook award tickets?

Yes, it does

What happens if a flight is disrupted more than once?

You can self-rebook once per every disruption.

criteria.criterion: If part of the ticket has been used in an involuntary refund case, the amount is at least the difference between the fare paid and the applicable fare for the portion used.
anchors: not less than the difference between the fare paid
mapped_evidence_text:
10.2.1 If we cancel a flight, fail to operate a flight reasonably according to schedule, fail to stop at your destination or Stopover, or cause you to miss a connecting flight on which you hold a reservation, the amount of the refund shall be:

10.2.1.1 if no portion of the Ticket has been used, an amount equal to the fare paid;

10.2.1.2 if a portion of the Ticket has been used, not less than the difference between the fare paid and the applicable fare for travel between the points for which the Ticket has been used.

10.3 VOLUNTARY REFUNDS

10.3.1 If you are entitled to a refund of your Ticket for reasons other than those set out in Article 10.2, the amount of the refund shall be:

10.3.1.1 if no portion of the Ticket has been used, an amount equal to the fare paid, less any reasonable service charges or cancellation fees;

10.3.1.2 if a portion of the Ticket has been used, the refund will be an amount equal to the difference between the fare paid and the applicable fare for travel between the points for which the Ticket has been used, less any reasonable service charges or cancellation fees.

10.4 RIGHT TO REFUSE REFUND

10.4.1 We may refuse a refund where application is made after the expiry of the validity of the Ticket.

10.4.2 We may refuse a refund on a Ticket which has been presented to us, or to Government officials, as evidence of intention to depart from that country, unless you establish to our satisfaction that you have permission to remain in the country or that you will depart from that country by another carrier or another means of transport. 10.6 CURRENCY We reserve the right to make a refund in the same manner and the same currency used to pay for the Ticket.

10.5 BY WHOM TICKET REFUNDABLE

Mobile Money

For your convenience, we offer a range of mobile money payment options to make booking your flight easier.

These Include:

Mpesa

M-Pesa (M for mobile, pesa is Swahili for money) is a mobile phone-based money transfer service. Operating in Kenya and Tanzania. Once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

Airtel Money

This is a mobile money transfer service. Operating in Kenya, Tanzania and other countries. Once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

Equitel

Equitel is a mobile payment option from Kenya. Once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

Vodacom Mpesa

This is Vodacom mpesa is a mobile money transfer service in Tanzania. Once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

MTN Mobile Money

MTN Mobile money is a secure mobile money wallet used to store funds, send and receive money. Guests can pay for their tickets though this mobile money option and once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

Tigo Pesa

This mobile money payment option is available in Tanzania. Tigo Pesa allows customers to send and receive money, buy airtime, pay bills, pay for goods and services from their mobile phones. Once the guest opts to make a payment via Tigo pesa, the e-ticket is sent to their email address.

Payment Methods

Payment Methods Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/book-manage/booking-online/payment-methods/

Kenya Airways offers a wide selection of online payment options for customers to buy their ticket online. You can pay with all common credit and debit cards such as Visa, MasterCard, American Express and also using alternative payment methods such as PayPal and M-pesa and many others that we accept.

Below are the types of available payment options to make payment easy for you.

Local and International Cards

Kenya Airways offers a wide variety of safe and convenient card payment options for purchasing flights and extra services.

Accepted Cards Include:

MasterCard

MasterCard is one of the largest card schemes in the world. Its principal business is to process payments between the banks of merchants and the card-issuing banks or credit unions of the purchasers who use the "MasterCard" brand debit, credit and prepaid cards to make purchases. criteria.criterion: Ordinary live pets are not accepted in the cabin or as checked-in animals in the hold.
anchors: Live animals shall be consigned as cargo only
mapped_evidence_text:
Pet Carriage

Pet Carriage website link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/pet-carriage/

Live animals will not be accepted as checked-in Animal in Hold (AVIH) or Pet in Cabin (PETC) on Kenya Airways flights.

Live animals shall be consigned as cargo only.

Exception

Service Dog

Service dog shall be accepted in the cabin if it’s providing assistance to a person with disability i.e. Blind guest, a person with mental or psychiatric disorder. The dog is certified and individually trained to provide assistance to a person with a disability.

For more information on health and import documents needed to transport a service dog, contact KQ Cargo for guidance.

Note: All service dogs must be trained to be accepted. Emotional support dogs are no longer considered as service animals.

Passengers with physical, sensory, psychiatric, intellectual, or other mental disabilities who need to travel with a service dog may be required to present certain documentation from a licensed medical health professional that is treating the passenger, dated within one year, stating that the service dog is necessary for the passenger/s mental health or treatment during air travel and/or any activity at the passengers’ destination.

Service Dogs are:

[List level 1] - Accepted free of charge.

[List level 1] - They can be accepted in the cabin without a kennel/cage provided they are properly harnessed and do not occupy a seat.

[List level 1] - Service dogs are trained to behave properly. An animal that shows disruptive behavior cannot be accepted as a guide animal even if it performs assistive function for the guest.

mapped_evidence_text:
8.6.3 Checked Baggage will, whenever possible, be carried on the same aircraft as you, unless we decide for safety, security or operational reasons to carry it on an alternative flight. If your Checked Baggage is carried on a subsequent flight we will deliver it to you, unless applicable law requires you to be present for customs clearance.

8.7 Unchecked Baggage

8.7.1 We may specify maximum dimensions and/or weight for Baggage which you carry on to the aircraft. If we have not done so, Baggage which you carry onto the aircraft must fit under the seat in front of you or in an enclosed storage compartment in the cabin of the aircraft. If your Baggage cannot be stored in this manner, or is of excessive weight, or is considered unsafe for any reason, it must be carried as Checked Baggage, subject to Articles 8.2 and 8.3.

8.7.2 Objects not suitable for carriage in the cargo compartment (such as delicate musical instruments), and which do not meet the requirements in Article 8.7.1 above, will only be accepted for carriage in the cabin compartment if you have given us notice in advance and permission has been granted by us. You may be required to pay a separate charge for this service.

8.8 Collection and Delivery of Checked Baggage

8.8.1 Subject to Article 8.6.3, you are required to collect your Checked Baggage as soon as it is made available at your destination or Stopover. Should you not collect it within a reasonable time, we may charge you a storage fee. Should your Checked Baggage not be claimed within three (3) months of the time it is made available, we may dispose of it without any liability to you.

8.8.2 Only the bearer of the Baggage Check and Baggage Identification Tag is entitled to delivery of the Checked Baggage.

criteria.criterion: Yes, the disruption self-rebooking tool supports award tickets.
anchors: Does the tool rebook award tickets?
mapped_evidence_text:
However, if you would like to see more flight options, go to the Kenya Airways website and click on Manage my booking where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

If my outbound flight has been changed, can I also change the inbound flight free of charge?

No. With the self-rebooking tool, you will only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors. If you wish to change the inbound because you lost a day(s) on the outbound, you will have to reach out to your travel agent or our Contact center office.

If checked-in, will the bags be transferred automatically to the new flight?

Yes, they will be transferred automatically.

Does the tool rebook other airlines document with KQ sectors like DL or AF?

Yes, it does. However, instead of revalidation, the ticket will be reissued.

Does the tool rebook award tickets?

Yes, it does

What happens if a flight is disrupted more than once?

You can self-rebook once per every disruption.

criteria.criterion: A passenger receiving at least one bag may not be entitled to first needs allowance.
expected_documents: Delayed or Lost or Damaged Baggage.docx
anchors: Passengers receiving at least one of their bags
mapped_evidence_text:
Payment may be made to passengers who arrive at destinations other than their domicile country of residence without their checked baggage. It shall be noted that not all such passengers may need payment.

NOTE: Persons who are residents do not qualify for first needs payment, unless they show proof of residence in another country other than their domicile country for the last 6 months.

The following provisions shall therefore apply for delayed bags not received within 24hrs at the arrival airport where the missing report was filed: after 24 hours:

[List level 1] - First Needs Allowance (FNA) may be paid on the spot where it is ascertained that based on flight schedules, frequencies and connectivity, the missing bags shall not arrive within 24hours.

[List level 1] - Passengers receiving at least one of their bags may not be entitled to First Needs Allowance.

[List level 1] - Proof of Purchase of first needs items in form of receipts is required;

[List level 1] - Only essential items can be reimbursed;

[List level 1] - Applicable limits are:

[List level 1] - USD150 for First class and Premier World

[List level 1] - USD100 for Economy class passengers

[List level 1] - Children between 2-12 yrs. are entitled to 50% of the applicable limits in Economy and Business Class

[List level 1] - Children below 2 years are not entitled to First Needs Allowance Payment.

[List level 1] - Passengers traveling on award tickets are entitled to First Needs Allowance at the applicable class of ticketing.

[List level 1] - Staff on Duty and on leisure rebate travel is entitled to First Needs allowance at the applicable class of ticketing.

anchors: mobile payment option from Kenya
mapped_evidence_text:
American Express Company (Amex) is an American multinational corporation specialized in payment card services. We accept both debit and credit cards for Amex.

On pay page choose payment options, next select the organization that issued the credit card. Enter all necessary details and confirm your booking. Once your payment has been authorized, you will be sent an e-ticket and payment confirmation by e-mail.

Mobile Money

For your convenience, we offer a range of mobile money payment options to make booking your flight easier.

These Include:

Mpesa

M-Pesa (M for mobile, pesa is Swahili for money) is a mobile phone-based money transfer service. Operating in Kenya and Tanzania. Once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

Airtel Money

This is a mobile money transfer service. Operating in Kenya, Tanzania and other countries. Once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

Equitel

Equitel is a mobile payment option from Kenya. Once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

Vodacom Mpesa

This is Vodacom mpesa is a mobile money transfer service in Tanzania. Once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

MTN Mobile Money

MTN Mobile money is a secure mobile money wallet used to store funds, send and receive money. Guests can pay for their tickets though this mobile money option and once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

Tigo Pesa

This mobile money payment option is available in Tanzania. Tigo Pesa allows customers to send and receive money, buy airtime, pay bills, pay for goods and services from their mobile phones. Once the guest opts to make a payment via Tigo pesa, the e-ticket is sent to their email address.

3.2.3 If after having commenced your journey, you are prevented from travelling within the period of validity of the Ticket by reason of illness, we may extend the period of validity of your Ticket until the date when you become fit to travel or until our first flight after such date, from the point where the journey is resumed on which space is available in the class of service for which the fare has been paid. Such illness must be attested to by a medical certificate. When the flight coupons remaining in the Ticket, or in the case of an Electronic Ticket, the electronic coupon, involve one or more Stopovers, the validity of such Ticket may be extended for not more than three months from the date shown on such certificate. In such circumstances, we will similarly extend the period of validity of Tickets of other members of your immediate family accompanying you.

3.2.4 In the event of death of a Passenger en route, the Tickets of persons accompanying the Passenger may be modified by waiving the minimum stay or extending the validity. In the event of a death in the immediate family of a Passenger who has commenced travel, the validity of the Passenger's Tickets and those of his or her immediate family who are accompanying the Passenger may likewise be modified. Any such modification shall be made upon receipt of a valid death certificate and any such extension of validity shall not be for a period longer than forty-five (45) Days from the date of the death. We will use reasonable efforts to accommodate such modifications on the earliest available flights.

3.3 COUPON SEQUENCE AND USE

Baggage Restrictions

Link to Baggage Restrictions website page: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/baggage-restrictions/

Please ensure that you do not pack items specified in this list in your carry-on or checked baggage.

Medically necessary needles and syringes are exempt from these prohibitions if passengers have in their possession prescription medication with a professionally printed label that identifies the medical office, pharmacy, or manufacturer of the medication.

Prohibited Items

For the safety of our passengers and aircraft, passengers are prohibited from carrying the following items in either checked or hand baggage:

[List level 1] - Explosives, munitions, fireworks, and flares

[List level 1] - Security-type cases/boxes incorporating goods such as lithium batteries or pyrotechnics

[List level 1] - Compressed gases (flammable, non-flammable, or poisonous) such as butane, propane, aqualung cylinders, lighter fuels, or refills

[List level 1] - Oxidizing substances such as bleaching powder and peroxides

[List level 1] - Flammable liquids such as paints and adhesives

[List level 1] - Disabling devices such as mace or pepper sprays, with irritant properties

[List level 1] - Poisons such as arsenic, cyanides, or insecticides

[List level 1] - Radioactive materials

[List level 1] - Corrosive materials such as mercury (which may be contained in thermometers or blood pressure gauges,) acids, alkalis, and wet cell batteries

[List level 1] - Any other substances which, during a flight, present a danger not covered above, such as magnetized, offensive, or irritating materials

criteria.criterion: The operating carrier governs operational and service matters such as boarding and baggage handling.
anchors: Conditions of Carriage of the operating carrier
mapped_evidence_text:
"STOPOVER" means a scheduled stop on your journey, at a point between the place of departure and the place of destination.

"TARIFF" means the published fares, charges and/or related conditions of carriage of an airline filed, where required, with the appropriate authorities.

"TICKET" means either the document entitled "Passenger Ticket and Baggage Check" or the Electronic Ticket, in each case issued by us or on our behalf, and includes the Conditions of Contract, notices and Coupons.

"UNCHECKED BAGGAGE" means any of your Baggage other than Checked Baggage.

ARTICLE 2 APPLICABILITY

2.1 GENERAL Except as provided in Articles 2.2 , 2.4 and 2.5, our Conditions of Carriage apply only to those flights, or flight segments, where our name or Airline Designator Code is indicated in the carrier box of the Ticket for that flight or flight segment.

2.2 CHARTER OPERATIONS If carriage is performed pursuant to a charter agreement, these Conditions of Carriage apply only to the extent they are incorporated, by reference or otherwise, in the charter agreement or the Ticket.

2.3 CODE SHARES On some services we may have arrangements with other carriers known as "Code Shares". This means that even if you have a reservation with us and hold a ticket where our name or airline designator code is indicated as the carrier, another carrier may operate the aircraft. If such arrangements apply, we will advise you of the carrier operating the aircraft at the time you make a reservation. In such cases, the Conditions of Carriage of the operating carrier will govern all operational and service-related matters (including boarding, in-flight service, delays, and baggage handling), while our Conditions of Carriage will govern contractual matters such as ticketing, refunds, and liability.

mapped_evidence_text:
[List level 1] - Odd size baggage cannot always be accepted. Acceptance depends on the capacity of the aircraft operating on the passenger’s routing. If the baggage cannot be accommodated on one of the aircraft, it cannot be accepted for the whole route. The reply to the SSR shall then be UN, in which case the sale agents shall inform the passenger immediately.

[List level 1] - When a passenger presents special baggage for check-in, the Customer Service Agent shall check the PNR of the passenger to verify whether transportation has been granted.

[List level 1] - If the special clearance is missing in the customer records, the station shall decide to accept it for transport, provided KQ procedures are strictly adhered to.

More Information

Bulky Baggage:

[List level 1] - For any baggage whose dimensions are larger than 300cm (Length +Width height) or heavier than 32kgs authorization shall be given prior travel by the commercial team. Lower limitation may apply for sports equipment.

[List level 1] - Authorization will appear in the PNR with “XBAG comment”. If the baggage exceeds 32kgs or 300cms a “bulky XBAG transportation” message specifying the type and the dimensions is sent to the station.

[List level 1] - There is no weight limitation for wheelchair and mobility device however a comment has to be given on the PNR to enable plan for the right aircraft and ground handling process.

Fragile Baggage:

[List level 1] - Kenya Airways accepts no liability for fragile baggage, baggage with fragile contents, perishable items e-g food, meat, flowers etc. and Valuable. This information should be given to the passenger before accepting of such items.

criteria.criterion: Self-rebooking retains destination, travel class and baggage allowance.
anchors: all your service selections remain the same
mapped_evidence_text:
It is a self-service option by Kenya Airways that allows you to rebook your flight easily in case your flight is canceled or rescheduled.

Will I be charged to use the self-rebooking service?

No, The service is absolutely free.

Will my flight preferences and services remain the same?

Yes, all your service selections remain the same. I.e. same destination, same travel class, same baggage allowances.

What do I need to rebook myself?

You only need your booking reference or e-ticket number.

Where do I go to rebook my flight?

Simply visit the Kenya Airways website(Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/ ), select “Manage Booking”

You will find the rebooking link at the top marked “Click here.

Where do I find the flight options available for rebooking?

Once you log in, you will be redirected to a page that has all available flight options and timings.

*Flight timings available for rebooking are either less than 24 hours from your original flight or 7 days after.

Can I rebook a flight that hasn’t been disrupted?

No. Only flights with a schedule change i.e. delayed or canceled are open for self-rebooking.

What happens if I do not rebook myself/are not able to rebook?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight, after which you will receive an email with your new flight details.

Will I receive my e-ticket and boarding pass?

Yes, after you have selected and confirmed your new flight, you will receive an email confirmation as well as your e-ticket.

I have received an email that my flight has been canceled/rescheduled. Does that mean I have been rebooked?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight. If you are happy with the new flight details highlighted on the email, click on “ACCEPT CHANGES”

15.5.1 We will not be liable for damage to unchecked Baggage unless such damage is caused by our negligence. We are not liable for any damage arising from our compliance with applicable laws or Government rules and regulations or from your failure to comply with the same.

15.5.2 Except in the case of an act or omission done with intent to cause damage or recklessly and with knowledge that damage would probably result, or where you have made a special declaration of interest and paid any fee required by us, our liability in the case of destruction, loss, damage or delay of Baggage shall be limited as provided by the Convention, ie:

15.5.2.1 where the Warsaw Convention applies, the applicable limit is normally taken to be 17 Special Drawing Rights per kilo for checked Baggage and 332 Special Drawing Rights in the case of unchecked Baggage, provided that if in accordance with applicable law different limits of liability are applicable such different limits shall apply. If the weight of your checked Baggage is not recorded on the baggage check, it is presumed that the total weight of the checked Baggage does not exceed the applicable free baggage allowance for the class of carriage concerned;

15.5.2.2 where the Montreal Convention applies, the applicable limit is 1,519 Special Drawing Rights per Passenger (or any such sum as provided under Article 22 paragraph 2 of the Montreal Convention).

15.5.3 We are not liable for any damage caused by your Baggage. You shall be responsible for any damage caused by your Baggage to other persons or property, including our property.

criteria.criterion: If the passenger cannot or does not self-rebook, the system automatically rebooks them on the next available flight.
anchors: automatically rebook you on the next available flight
mapped_evidence_text:
It is a self-service option by Kenya Airways that allows you to rebook your flight easily in case your flight is canceled or rescheduled.

Will I be charged to use the self-rebooking service?

No, The service is absolutely free.

Will my flight preferences and services remain the same?

Yes, all your service selections remain the same. I.e. same destination, same travel class, same baggage allowances.

What do I need to rebook myself?

You only need your booking reference or e-ticket number.

Where do I go to rebook my flight?

Simply visit the Kenya Airways website(Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/ ), select “Manage Booking”

You will find the rebooking link at the top marked “Click here.

Where do I find the flight options available for rebooking?

Once you log in, you will be redirected to a page that has all available flight options and timings.

*Flight timings available for rebooking are either less than 24 hours from your original flight or 7 days after.

Can I rebook a flight that hasn’t been disrupted?

No. Only flights with a schedule change i.e. delayed or canceled are open for self-rebooking.

What happens if I do not rebook myself/are not able to rebook?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight, after which you will receive an email with your new flight details.

Will I receive my e-ticket and boarding pass?

Yes, after you have selected and confirmed your new flight, you will receive an email confirmation as well as your e-ticket.

I have received an email that my flight has been canceled/rescheduled. Does that mean I have been rebooked?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight. If you are happy with the new flight details highlighted on the email, click on “ACCEPT CHANGES”

criteria.criterion: Families or parties travelling together and checking in at the same time to the same destination may pool the number of pieces.
anchors: pooling the number of baggage but not the weight per piece
mapped_evidence_text:
IATA Resolution 302 determines the Most Significant Carrier (MSC) whose baggage allowance is applied when the journey involves Interline partners. Journeys that involve interline partners/codeshare partners apply different baggage allowances:

[List level 1] - The free baggage allowance shown on the ticket, the trip summary or in the check in system for interline or code share flights is granted.

[List level 1] - For flights originating or terminating to the US/CANADA, piece concept applies based on the specified weight.

[List level 1] - Excess baggage charges are applied through to the final destination.

Pooling of Allowance

[List level 1] - Pooling of excess bags is allowed for families or a group or party travelling to a common destination e.g. sportsmen, affinity groups etc.

[List level 1] - The families or group or party shall be travelling together and check-in their baggage to the same destination on the same flight(s) at the same time.

[List level 1] - Each individual passenger shall always be given their own individual baggage” claim” tag.

[List level 1] - For security reasons only families are allowed to register their checked baggage in one check-in record.

[List level 1] - For groups during check-in, each passenger in the group will check-in their baggage individually but the total allowance for the group applies.

[List level 1] - Excess charges apply if:

1. Each piece checked in exceeds the free weight allowance or piece/s allowed for all the family members, group or party.

Note: The pooling consist in pooling the number of baggage but not the weight per piece for example if Free Baggage Allowance = 2PC of 23 kg each, customers cannot come with 1 bag of 18 kg and another of 26 kg).

8.4.2 We may refuse to carry as Baggage any item reasonably considered by us to be unsuitable for carriage because of its size, shape, weight, content or character, or for safety or operational reasons, or in the interests of the comfort of other passengers. Information about unacceptable items is available upon request.

8.4.3 We may refuse to accept Baggage for carriage unless it is in our reasonable opinion properly and securely packed in suitable containers. Information about packing and containers unacceptable to us is available upon request.

8.5 Right of Search

For reasons of safety and security we may request that you permit a search and scan of your person and a search, scan or x-ray of your Baggage. If you are not available, your Baggage may be searched in your absence for the purpose of determining whether you are in possession of or whether you’re Baggage contains any item described in Article 8.3.1 or any firearms, ammunition or weapons which have not been presented to us in accordance with Articles 8.3.2 or 8.3.3. If you are unwilling to comply with such request we may refuse to carry you and your Baggage. In the event a search or scan causes Damage to you, or an x-ray or scan causes damage to your Baggage, we shall not be liable for such Damage unless due to our fault or negligence.

8.6 Checked Baggage

8.6.1 Upon delivery to us of your Baggage which you wish to check, we will take custody of, and issue a Baggage Identification Tag for, each piece of your Checked Baggage.

8.6.2 Checked Baggage must have your name or other personal identification affixed to it.

criteria.criterion: An eligible award-ticket passenger can receive first needs allowance at the applicable ticketed class limit.
expected_documents: Delayed or Lost or Damaged Baggage.docx
anchors: Passengers traveling on award tickets are entitled
mapped_evidence_text:
Payment may be made to passengers who arrive at destinations other than their domicile country of residence without their checked baggage. It shall be noted that not all such passengers may need payment.

NOTE: Persons who are residents do not qualify for first needs payment, unless they show proof of residence in another country other than their domicile country for the last 6 months.

The following provisions shall therefore apply for delayed bags not received within 24hrs at the arrival airport where the missing report was filed: after 24 hours:

[List level 1] - First Needs Allowance (FNA) may be paid on the spot where it is ascertained that based on flight schedules, frequencies and connectivity, the missing bags shall not arrive within 24hours.

[List level 1] - Passengers receiving at least one of their bags may not be entitled to First Needs Allowance.

[List level 1] - Proof of Purchase of first needs items in form of receipts is required;

[List level 1] - Only essential items can be reimbursed;

[List level 1] - Applicable limits are:

[List level 1] - USD150 for First class and Premier World

[List level 1] - USD100 for Economy class passengers

[List level 1] - Children between 2-12 yrs. are entitled to 50% of the applicable limits in Economy and Business Class

[List level 1] - Children below 2 years are not entitled to First Needs Allowance Payment.

[List level 1] - Passengers traveling on award tickets are entitled to First Needs Allowance at the applicable class of ticketing.

[List level 1] - Staff on Duty and on leisure rebate travel is entitled to First Needs allowance at the applicable class of ticketing.

anchors: pay a charge for carriage of Baggage in excess
mapped_evidence_text:
Baggage Conditions Rules

Baggage Conditions link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/conditions-of-carriage-baggage/

Article 8 Baggage

8.1 Free Baggage Allowance

You may carry some Baggage, free of charge, subject to our conditions and limitations, which are available on our website Baggage information (Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/ )

8.2 Excess Baggage

You will be required to pay a charge for carriage of Baggage in excess of the free Baggage allowance. To learn more about  the rates kindly reach out to us on +254711024747.

8.3 Items Unacceptable as Baggage

8.3.1 You must not include in your Baggage:

8.3.1.2 Items the carriage of which is prohibited by the applicable laws, regulations or orders of any state to be flown from or to;

8.3.1.3 Items which are reasonably considered by us to be unsuitable for carriage because they are dangerous or unsafe, or because of their weight, size, shape or character, or because they are fragile or perishable having regard to, among other things, the type of aircraft being used. Information about unacceptable items is available upon request.

8.3.2 Firearms and ammunition other than for hunting and sporting purposes are prohibited from carriage as Baggage. Firearms and ammunition for hunting and sporting purposes may be accepted as Checked Baggage. Firearms must be unloaded, with the safety catch on, and suitably packed. Carriage of ammunition is subject to ICAO and IATA regulations as specified in Article 8.3.1.1.

8.3.3 3 Weapons such as antique firearms, swords, knives and similar items may be accepted as Checked Baggage, at our discretion, but will not be permitted in the cabin of the aircraft.

Extra Seat for Cabin Baggage, Cargo, Mail (CBBG) or Passenger Comfort (EXST)

Extra seat(s) can be booked for passenger’s comfort (e.g. leg rest, etc.) or for stowage of cabin baggage (e.g. valuables, diplomatic pouch, fragile items, musical instruments, paintings etc.)

Baggage Allowance for an Extra seat purchased

Acceptance Conditions

[List level 1] - Extra seat(s) shall be requested and paid for in advance. Approval is needed from Revenue Management.

[List level 1] - The normal applicable free checked baggage allowance applies for every extra seat booked (EXST). For example, 1 passenger books 2 extra M-Class seats for comfort. The total checked baggage allowance for this passenger will be 3 x applicable free baggage allowance.

[List level 1] - If a seat is used to place items on (CBBG), these items may not weigh more than 46 kg per seat.

[List level 1] - (The kilos placed on a seat, shall not be deducted from the total free checked baggage allowance.) Items placed on a seat should be adequately packed to prevent damage.

[List level 1] - Trunks and crates are not allowed as CBBG.

[List level 1] - Items must be stored on a seat and be properly secured by a safety belt or restraint device having enough strength to eliminate the possibility of shifting under all normal anticipated flight and ground conditions.

[List level 1] - The item shall be adequately packaged or covered in a manner to avoid possible injury to passengers and cabin crew members.

[List level 1] - Extra seats for stowage of items shall not be issued on the emergency exit row.

mapped_evidence_text:
However, if you would like to see more flight options, go to the Kenya Airways website and click on Manage my booking where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

If my outbound flight has been changed, can I also change the inbound flight free of charge?

No. With the self-rebooking tool, you will only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors. If you wish to change the inbound because you lost a day(s) on the outbound, you will have to reach out to your travel agent or our Contact center office.

If checked-in, will the bags be transferred automatically to the new flight?

Yes, they will be transferred automatically.

Does the tool rebook other airlines document with KQ sectors like DL or AF?

Yes, it does. However, instead of revalidation, the ticket will be reissued.

Does the tool rebook award tickets?

Yes, it does

What happens if a flight is disrupted more than once?

You can self-rebook once per every disruption.

criteria.criterion: Standard special meals are requested at least 24 hours before departure.
anchors: at least 24 hours
mapped_evidence_text:
[List level 1] - Nut allergies: Kenya Airways cannot guarantee a nut free environment. Nuts may be served as snacks, could be part of the ingredients used while preparing our inflight our meals or other guests may bring food on the aircraft that contain nuts. Nut residue oils can also be passed onto the seats, air conditioning or from other surfaces on the aircraft. As Kenya Airways is not able to accept responsibility for guests with nut allergic reactions, we suggest you discuss your travel plans with your doctor prior to travelling with us. You can also bring your own meal on the flight.

[List level 1] - Seafood Meal (SFML): This meal is prepared according to passenger preference; fish and/or seafood prepared according to local specifications.

[List level 1] - Special Meal (SPML): This meal is prepared according to passenger preference; it is a special meal request that the airline wishes to accommodate for which there is no specific meal code.

[List level 1] - Timing: Make sure to request your special meal at least 24 hours before your flight's departure

[List level 1] - Booking Channels: You have various options to place your request:

[List level 1] - Online using the Book and Manage feature on the Kenya Airways website

[List level 1] - Contact our 24-hour call centre at +254 711 024 747

[List level 1] - At any Kenya Airways sales office

[List level 1] - Through your travel agency

Your comfort and satisfaction matter to us, and we are dedicated to ensuring your culinary preferences are met during your flight with Kenya Airways. If you have any inquiries or need assistance, our team is always ready to help. We look forward to providing you with a delightful dining experience on board.

Medical & Special Needs Assistance

[List level 1] - Need battery-powered* medical equipment (except for CPAP) or a medical procedure during the flight

If you have any of the above or other medical conditions, download and complete the MEDIF (Medical Information Form for Fitness to Fly) at least 24 hours before travel is due to commence and submit to doctors.kq@kenya-airways.com or our 24-hour Contact Centre Tel: +254 734 104 747, Mobile: +254 711 024 747 or WhatsApp: +254 705 474 747 for assistance.

2. Passenger Medical Clearance Services Process

Once cleared, we shall provide you with a Passenger Medical Clearance form (PMC) stating the conditions of clearance. You will be required to carry this form throughout your travel.

Kindly note:

[List level 1] - The MEDIF and any other medical report MUST be filled in English. It is valid for 7 days from the date of issue.

[List level 1] - The MEDIF MUST be completed fully including the passenger declaration part. It MUST be signed, stamped and dated clearly. Failure to fill it will lead to a delay in the clearance process.

[List level 1] - You will need a new MEDIF form for clearance on your return trip

[List level 1] - Notify Doctors.KQ@kenya-airways.com immediately of any change in your condition before your flight; If your condition changes significantly, you may be asked to obtain another MEDIF form to confirm that you are fit to fly

[List level 1] - You are required to do prior arrangement for any ground support services before and after your flight except as provided by applicable law. This includes connecting points and onward flights e.g. ambulift, ambulance, oxygen, hospital and pre-hospital ambulance services. Kenya Airways medical can facilitate this *facilitation fees will apply)

***All equipment that may be required in-flight MUST be approved by the Kenya Airways Engineering department at least 24hours before the flight.

Pre-flight

Book our fast-track, pre-ﬂight assessment for clearance to ﬂy within one working day if you are in Nairobi at our JKIA clinic.

3. Medical Devices

We understand that it can be a hustle to travel with medical devices and we’re here to assist you.

[List level 1] - All medical devices intended to be used on board must be approved by IATA standards. Please provide details of the device before travel to doctors on call

[List level 1] - All medical devices must be dry-cell battery operated with sufficient battery supply for 1.5 times the flight duration and all batteries must be transported in accordance with applicable rules and regulations.

[List level 1] - All ventilated cases require prior submission of MEDIF form and approved case by case. When approved client must be accompanied by a physician experienced in aeromedical transportation.

[List level 1] - Portable oxygen concentrator: If you are carrying a battery-powered, portable oxygen concentrator on board as cabin baggage but do not intend to use it during the flight, the battery must be removed. It must be packaged separately unless the concentrator contains at least two protective features to prevent accidental operation during transport.

4. Medication on Board

We recommend to always carry your prescription, letter from your doctor and medication in your cabin baggage. Please note different countries have different regulations regarding carriage of medication hence important to check the regulations prior to travel.

criteria.criterion: After an online booking, cash can be paid at a participating ticket office.
anchors: Not all ticket offices accept cash payments
mapped_evidence_text:
Other Methods of Payment (AMOPs)

Mobile Banking or Bank Transfer

This form of payment is currently available in the Kenya, Nigeria and a few selected African countries. It is a real time 24-hour digital payment solution that allows for bank-to-bank transfers at a low cost. it is easy to use, fast, convenient, secure and affordable. This option is available for online banking, mobile apps, and USSD mobile banking.

Cash Payment

You can pay by cash after you have made your online booking. You then pay and retrieve your ticket at a Kenya Airways ticket office. Important to note: there is usually a fee charged for cash payments. If you wish to pay at the ticket office, make sure to bring along the booking confirmation or booking code that you received by e-mail. Please note: Not all ticket offices accept cash payments.

Online banking, also known as ‘Real Time Online Banking’ (RTOB), allows you to shop and pay online safely and easily. Payment services include the below:

PayPal

We accept PayPal as one of the convenient online payment methods. Customers with a PayPal account can make payments on our website and confirm their ticket payment securely. Once the payment confirmation is received, we will issue the electronic ticket to the customer via email.

China Union Pay

China Union Pay or by its abbreviation, CUP or UPI internationally, is a Chinese state-owned financial services corporation headquartered in Shanghai, China. It provides bank card services and a major card scheme in mainland China. Enter all necessary details and confirm your booking. Once your payment has been authorized, you will be sent an e-ticket and payment confirmation by e-mail.

Alipay

criteria.criterion: If part of the ticket has been used in an involuntary refund case, the amount is at least the difference between the fare paid and the applicable fare for the portion used.
anchors: not less than the difference between the fare paid
mapped_evidence_text:
10.2.1 If we cancel a flight, fail to operate a flight reasonably according to schedule, fail to stop at your destination or Stopover, or cause you to miss a connecting flight on which you hold a reservation, the amount of the refund shall be:

10.2.1.1 if no portion of the Ticket has been used, an amount equal to the fare paid;

10.2.1.2 if a portion of the Ticket has been used, not less than the difference between the fare paid and the applicable fare for travel between the points for which the Ticket has been used.

10.3 VOLUNTARY REFUNDS

10.3.1 If you are entitled to a refund of your Ticket for reasons other than those set out in Article 10.2, the amount of the refund shall be:

10.3.1.1 if no portion of the Ticket has been used, an amount equal to the fare paid, less any reasonable service charges or cancellation fees;

10.3.1.2 if a portion of the Ticket has been used, the refund will be an amount equal to the difference between the fare paid and the applicable fare for travel between the points for which the Ticket has been used, less any reasonable service charges or cancellation fees.

10.4 RIGHT TO REFUSE REFUND

10.4.1 We may refuse a refund where application is made after the expiry of the validity of the Ticket.

10.4.2 We may refuse a refund on a Ticket which has been presented to us, or to Government officials, as evidence of intention to depart from that country, unless you establish to our satisfaction that you have permission to remain in the country or that you will depart from that country by another carrier or another means of transport. 10.6 CURRENCY We reserve the right to make a refund in the same manner and the same currency used to pay for the Ticket.

10.5 BY WHOM TICKET REFUNDABLE

anchors: items will be retrieved at the boarding gate
mapped_evidence_text:
[List level 1] - Lighters (butane, absorbed fuel, electric, battery-powered, and novelty lighters) are not to be carried on the person, or in the carry-on and checked baggage. This ruling by The Transportation Security Administration (TSA) applies to all passengers arriving into or departing from United States of America.

Restricted Items

In addition, passengers are not allowed to carry the following items in their hand baggage for passengers’ safety and security reasons. To minimize inconvenience, you are advised to check in or put these items in your checked baggage instead:

[List level 1] - Knives (including hunting knives, swords, and pocket knives)

[List level 1] - Scissors and any other sharp/bladed objects (e.g. ice-pick, nail clippers) considered illegal by local law

[List level 1] - Weapons such as whips, baton, or stun gun

[List level 1] - Toys guns/gun shaped items or look-alikes, hand-cuffs

[List level 1] - Sporting equipment such as baseball/cricket bats, golf clubs, hockey sticks, billiard cues

[List level 1] - Devices with spillable batteries

[List level 1] - Aerosols (hair sprays, perfumes, medicines containing alcohol) not exceeding 0.5KG/L per article and 2.0KG/L in total weight

[List level 1] - Baby strollers

[List level 1] - Any other items which are deemed security hazards by local law

[List level 1] - Any other items that resemble or have similar functions to the above items

Please note that these items will be retrieved at the boarding gate by the local authorities and depending on local conditions, the items may not be returned to you.

Baggage Security Guidelines

Baggage Security Guidelines Web page: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/baggage-security-guidelines/

Security Removed Items

criteria.criterion: Passengers travelling from Jeddah may carry one free bottle of holy water, up to five litres.
anchors: one free bottle of Holy Water
mapped_evidence_text:
[List level 1] - As a mandatory standard each piece of checked in baggage shall have a name label that bears the passenger's name, physical address, and phone number on the outside and also on the inside. The name should be the same as the one mentioned on the ticket. An email address is also recommended.

Exceptions

[List level 1] - Guests travelling from Jeddah are allowed to carry one free bottle of Holy Water, Max 5 Litres. The bottle must be sealed with a plastic covering to avoid leakage. KQ has no liability on Holy Water, no claims shall be filed. Note: For ease of handling, the maximum weight of each piece of baggage shall not exceed 23kgs (50Ibs) and total dimensions shall not exceed 158cms (62 inches) (L+W+H)

[List level 1] - Under special conditions or authorization, non-normal item, motorized wheelchairs, special sporting equipment may be accepted as checked baggage with exceeding weight of 23kgs.

[List level 1] - In addition to free cabin baggage allowance, an infant is entitled to 1 collapsible stroller plus 1 car seat free of charge.

9.2.2.3 make a refund in accordance with the provisions of Article 10.2.

9.2.3 Upon the occurrence of any of the events set out in Article 9.2.2, except as otherwise provided by the Convention, the options outlined in Article 9.2.2.1 to 9.2.2.3 are the sole and exclusive remedies available to you and we shall have no further liability to you.

9.3 DENIED BOARDING COMPENSATION

If we are unable to provide previously confirmed space, we shall provide compensation to those Passengers denied boarding in accordance with applicable law and our denied boarding compensation policy. A copy of our denied boarding compensation policy is available upon request. Eligibility for denied boarding compensation is conditional on passengers having complied with check-in and boarding deadlines. Compensation may include monetary reimbursement, alternate transportation on another carrier, or downgrade refund, in accordance with applicable law and our denied boarding compensation policy.

ARTICLE 10: REFUNDS

10.1 We will refund a Ticket or any unused portion, in accordance with the applicable fare rules or Tariff, as follows:

10.1.1 Except as otherwise provided in this Article, we shall be entitled to make a refund either to the person named in the Ticket or to the person who has paid for the Ticket, upon presentation of satisfactory proof of such payment.

10.1.2 If a Ticket has been paid for by a person other than the Passenger named in the Ticket, and the Ticket indicates that there is a restriction on refund, we shall make a refund only to the person who paid for the Ticket, or to that person's order.

10.1.3 Refunds will only be made Subject to the ticket rules.

mapped_evidence_text:
Check-in

Enter your check-in information using this link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/book-manage/post-booking/check-in/

Escape the hassle of queues and maximize your time at the airport. Experience the convenience of online flight check-in – available from anywhere, at any time.

For international flights, the online check-in window opens 48 hours before your scheduled departure (24 hours before for flights involving the United States) and remains accessible until just 1 hour before takeoff. Domestic flight passengers are encouraged to complete their check-in at least one and a half hours prior to departure, with the counters closing 30 minutes before the flight leaves.

But that's not all – take control of your travel experience by selecting your preferred seats before you even step on the plane. Make your journey truly yours by securing your favorite spots in the cabin.

By optig for online check-in, you're not just saving time; you're ensuring a smooth and stress-free start to your journey. Say goodbye to long lines and hello to an effortless way to prepare for your flight

When can I Check in?

Online Check-in:

With an electronic ticket, online check-in can be performed from 48 hours up until 1 hour before departure. By taking advantage of this service, you can bypass long lines at selected airports and even pick your preferred seat. Once completed, you can print your boarding pass at your convenience. When you arrive at the airport, use the designated online check-in drop-off point for your luggage and then proceed to the boarding gate. Kenya Airways has taken online check-in to new heights, providing a smoother and more convenient experience.

International Check-in:

criteria.criterion: The self-rebooking tool only changes disrupted sectors free of charge.
anchors: only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors
mapped_evidence_text:
However, if you would like to see more flight options, go to the Kenya Airways website and click on Manage my booking where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

If my outbound flight has been changed, can I also change the inbound flight free of charge?

No. With the self-rebooking tool, you will only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors. If you wish to change the inbound because you lost a day(s) on the outbound, you will have to reach out to your travel agent or our Contact center office.

If checked-in, will the bags be transferred automatically to the new flight?

Yes, they will be transferred automatically.

Does the tool rebook other airlines document with KQ sectors like DL or AF?

Yes, it does. However, instead of revalidation, the ticket will be reissued.

Does the tool rebook award tickets?

Yes, it does

What happens if a flight is disrupted more than once?

You can self-rebook once per every disruption.

mapped_evidence_text:
Baggage Restrictions

Link to Baggage Restrictions website page: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/baggage-restrictions/

Please ensure that you do not pack items specified in this list in your carry-on or checked baggage.

Medically necessary needles and syringes are exempt from these prohibitions if passengers have in their possession prescription medication with a professionally printed label that identifies the medical office, pharmacy, or manufacturer of the medication.

Prohibited Items

For the safety of our passengers and aircraft, passengers are prohibited from carrying the following items in either checked or hand baggage:

[List level 1] - Explosives, munitions, fireworks, and flares

[List level 1] - Security-type cases/boxes incorporating goods such as lithium batteries or pyrotechnics

[List level 1] - Compressed gases (flammable, non-flammable, or poisonous) such as butane, propane, aqualung cylinders, lighter fuels, or refills

[List level 1] - Oxidizing substances such as bleaching powder and peroxides

[List level 1] - Flammable liquids such as paints and adhesives

[List level 1] - Disabling devices such as mace or pepper sprays, with irritant properties

[List level 1] - Poisons such as arsenic, cyanides, or insecticides

[List level 1] - Radioactive materials

[List level 1] - Corrosive materials such as mercury (which may be contained in thermometers or blood pressure gauges,) acids, alkalis, and wet cell batteries

[List level 1] - Any other substances which, during a flight, present a danger not covered above, such as magnetized, offensive, or irritating materials

If this is not the case, the guide dog cannot be accepted.

[List level 1] - Passengers with service dogs can be accepted on any seat in the cabin except exit rows.

[List level 1] - The information is also made available in the PIL in order to inform the crew.

Transportation of Dogs to USA

From July 14 through October 14, 2021, dogs coming from high risk countries (link: https://www.cdc.gov/importation/dogs/high-risk-countries.html ) with CDC Dog Import Permits can enter the United States at one of these 18 airports: Anchorage, Atlanta, Boston, Chicago (ORD), Dallas (DFW), Detroit, Honolulu, Houston (IAH), Los Angeles, Miami, Minneapolis, New York (JFK), Newark, Philadelphia, San Francisco, San Juan, Seattle, and Washington, DC (Dulles).

All dogs imported into the United States must be healthy on arrival. Dogs that have not been in a high-risk country in the previous 6 months are not required by CDC to present a rabies vaccination certificate or other paperwork, but vaccination against rabies is recommended.

These rules apply to all dogs, including puppies, service animals, and service dogs.

These rules also apply whether you are:

[List level 1] - Just visiting the United States with your dog

criteria.criterion: Tigo Pesa is an available mobile payment option in Tanzania.
anchors: available in Tanzania
mapped_evidence_text:
American Express Company (Amex) is an American multinational corporation specialized in payment card services. We accept both debit and credit cards for Amex.

On pay page choose payment options, next select the organization that issued the credit card. Enter all necessary details and confirm your booking. Once your payment has been authorized, you will be sent an e-ticket and payment confirmation by e-mail.

Mobile Money

For your convenience, we offer a range of mobile money payment options to make booking your flight easier.

These Include:

Mpesa

M-Pesa (M for mobile, pesa is Swahili for money) is a mobile phone-based money transfer service. Operating in Kenya and Tanzania. Once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

Airtel Money

This is a mobile money transfer service. Operating in Kenya, Tanzania and other countries. Once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

Equitel

Equitel is a mobile payment option from Kenya. Once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

Vodacom Mpesa

This is Vodacom mpesa is a mobile money transfer service in Tanzania. Once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

MTN Mobile Money

MTN Mobile money is a secure mobile money wallet used to store funds, send and receive money. Guests can pay for their tickets though this mobile money option and once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

Tigo Pesa

This mobile money payment option is available in Tanzania. Tigo Pesa allows customers to send and receive money, buy airtime, pay bills, pay for goods and services from their mobile phones. Once the guest opts to make a payment via Tigo pesa, the e-ticket is sent to their email address.

Human Remains

mapped_evidence_text:
10.2.1 If we cancel a flight, fail to operate a flight reasonably according to schedule, fail to stop at your destination or Stopover, or cause you to miss a connecting flight on which you hold a reservation, the amount of the refund shall be:

10.2.1.1 if no portion of the Ticket has been used, an amount equal to the fare paid;

10.2.1.2 if a portion of the Ticket has been used, not less than the difference between the fare paid and the applicable fare for travel between the points for which the Ticket has been used.

10.3 VOLUNTARY REFUNDS

10.3.1 If you are entitled to a refund of your Ticket for reasons other than those set out in Article 10.2, the amount of the refund shall be:

10.3.1.1 if no portion of the Ticket has been used, an amount equal to the fare paid, less any reasonable service charges or cancellation fees;

10.3.1.2 if a portion of the Ticket has been used, the refund will be an amount equal to the difference between the fare paid and the applicable fare for travel between the points for which the Ticket has been used, less any reasonable service charges or cancellation fees.

10.4 RIGHT TO REFUSE REFUND

10.4.1 We may refuse a refund where application is made after the expiry of the validity of the Ticket.

10.4.2 We may refuse a refund on a Ticket which has been presented to us, or to Government officials, as evidence of intention to depart from that country, unless you establish to our satisfaction that you have permission to remain in the country or that you will depart from that country by another carrier or another means of transport. 10.6 CURRENCY We reserve the right to make a refund in the same manner and the same currency used to pay for the Ticket.

8.3.4 You must not include in Checked Baggage money, jewellery, precious metals, computers, personal electronic devices, negotiable papers, securities or other valuables, business documents, passports and other identification documents or samples.

8.3.6 Air Carriage of Electronic Devices containing Lithium Batteries being Recalled.

On June 20, 2019 a notice for recall was issued for a limited number of older generation 15-inch MacBook Pro units supplied by Apple Inc. between September 2015 and February 2017. Following the recall notice, The European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) recommends that operators inform crews, passengers and staff about any restrictions and limitations on carrying such devices on board. If such a device is taken on board, the passenger is required to keep it switched off and not use or charge the device. Passengers should also be reminded to inform cabin crew immediately when a device is damaged, hot, produces smoke, is lost or falls into the seat structure. For more information, on the EASA bulletin kindly visit https://www.easa.europa.eu/newsroom-and-events/news/safety-precautions-regarding-transport-air-recalled-portable-electronic . mapped_evidence_text:
"STOPOVER" means a scheduled stop on your journey, at a point between the place of departure and the place of destination.

"TARIFF" means the published fares, charges and/or related conditions of carriage of an airline filed, where required, with the appropriate authorities.

"TICKET" means either the document entitled "Passenger Ticket and Baggage Check" or the Electronic Ticket, in each case issued by us or on our behalf, and includes the Conditions of Contract, notices and Coupons.

"UNCHECKED BAGGAGE" means any of your Baggage other than Checked Baggage.

ARTICLE 2 APPLICABILITY

2.1 GENERAL Except as provided in Articles 2.2 , 2.4 and 2.5, our Conditions of Carriage apply only to those flights, or flight segments, where our name or Airline Designator Code is indicated in the carrier box of the Ticket for that flight or flight segment.

2.2 CHARTER OPERATIONS If carriage is performed pursuant to a charter agreement, these Conditions of Carriage apply only to the extent they are incorporated, by reference or otherwise, in the charter agreement or the Ticket.

2.3 CODE SHARES On some services we may have arrangements with other carriers known as "Code Shares". This means that even if you have a reservation with us and hold a ticket where our name or airline designator code is indicated as the carrier, another carrier may operate the aircraft. If such arrangements apply, we will advise you of the carrier operating the aircraft at the time you make a reservation. In such cases, the Conditions of Carriage of the operating carrier will govern all operational and service-related matters (including boarding, in-flight service, delays, and baggage handling), while our Conditions of Carriage will govern contractual matters such as ticketing, refunds, and liability.

anchors: properly harnessed and do not occupy a seat
mapped_evidence_text:
Pet Carriage

Pet Carriage website link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/pet-carriage/

Live animals will not be accepted as checked-in Animal in Hold (AVIH) or Pet in Cabin (PETC) on Kenya Airways flights.

Live animals shall be consigned as cargo only.

Exception

Service Dog

Service dog shall be accepted in the cabin if it’s providing assistance to a person with disability i.e. Blind guest, a person with mental or psychiatric disorder. The dog is certified and individually trained to provide assistance to a person with a disability.

For more information on health and import documents needed to transport a service dog, contact KQ Cargo for guidance.

Note: All service dogs must be trained to be accepted. Emotional support dogs are no longer considered as service animals.

Passengers with physical, sensory, psychiatric, intellectual, or other mental disabilities who need to travel with a service dog may be required to present certain documentation from a licensed medical health professional that is treating the passenger, dated within one year, stating that the service dog is necessary for the passenger/s mental health or treatment during air travel and/or any activity at the passengers’ destination.

Service Dogs are:

[List level 1] - Accepted free of charge.

[List level 1] - They can be accepted in the cabin without a kennel/cage provided they are properly harnessed and do not occupy a seat.

[List level 1] - Service dogs are trained to behave properly. An animal that shows disruptive behavior cannot be accepted as a guide animal even if it performs assistive function for the guest.

mapped_evidence_text:
Baggage Restrictions

Link to Baggage Restrictions website page: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/baggage-restrictions/

Please ensure that you do not pack items specified in this list in your carry-on or checked baggage.

Medically necessary needles and syringes are exempt from these prohibitions if passengers have in their possession prescription medication with a professionally printed label that identifies the medical office, pharmacy, or manufacturer of the medication.

Prohibited Items

For the safety of our passengers and aircraft, passengers are prohibited from carrying the following items in either checked or hand baggage:

[List level 1] - Explosives, munitions, fireworks, and flares

[List level 1] - Security-type cases/boxes incorporating goods such as lithium batteries or pyrotechnics

[List level 1] - Compressed gases (flammable, non-flammable, or poisonous) such as butane, propane, aqualung cylinders, lighter fuels, or refills

[List level 1] - Oxidizing substances such as bleaching powder and peroxides

anchors: in Tanzania
mapped_evidence_text:
American Express Company (Amex) is an American multinational corporation specialized in payment card services. We accept both debit and credit cards for Amex.

On pay page choose payment options, next select the organization that issued the credit card. Enter all necessary details and confirm your booking. Once your payment has been authorized, you will be sent an e-ticket and payment confirmation by e-mail.

Mobile Money

For your convenience, we offer a range of mobile money payment options to make booking your flight easier.

These Include:

Mpesa

M-Pesa (M for mobile, pesa is Swahili for money) is a mobile phone-based money transfer service. Operating in Kenya and Tanzania. Once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

Airtel Money

This is a mobile money transfer service. Operating in Kenya, Tanzania and other countries. Once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

Equitel

Equitel is a mobile payment option from Kenya. Once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

Vodacom Mpesa

This is Vodacom mpesa is a mobile money transfer service in Tanzania. Once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

MTN Mobile Money

MTN Mobile money is a secure mobile money wallet used to store funds, send and receive money. Guests can pay for their tickets though this mobile money option and once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

Tigo Pesa

This mobile money payment option is available in Tanzania. Tigo Pesa allows customers to send and receive money, buy airtime, pay bills, pay for goods and services from their mobile phones. Once the guest opts to make a payment via Tigo pesa, the e-ticket is sent to their email address.

ARTICLE 16: TIME LIMITATION ON CLAIMS AND ACTIONS

16.1 NOTICE OF CLAIMS

Acceptance of Baggage by the bearer of the Baggage Check without complaint at the time of delivery is sufficient evidence that the Baggage has been delivered in good condition and in accordance with the contract of carriage, unless you prove otherwise.

Any right to damages shall be extinguished if an action is not brought within two years of the date of arrival at destination, or the date on which the aircraft was scheduled to arrive, or the date on which the carriage stopped. The method of calculating the period of limitation shall be determined by the law of the court where the case is heard.

criteria.criterion: Yes, the disruption self-rebooking tool supports award tickets.
anchors: Does the tool rebook award tickets?
mapped_evidence_text:
However, if you would like to see more flight options, go to the Kenya Airways website and click on Manage my booking where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

If my outbound flight has been changed, can I also change the inbound flight free of charge?

No. With the self-rebooking tool, you will only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors. If you wish to change the inbound because you lost a day(s) on the outbound, you will have to reach out to your travel agent or our Contact center office.

If checked-in, will the bags be transferred automatically to the new flight?

Yes, they will be transferred automatically.

Does the tool rebook other airlines document with KQ sectors like DL or AF?

Yes, it does. However, instead of revalidation, the ticket will be reissued.

Does the tool rebook award tickets?

Yes, it does

What happens if a flight is disrupted more than once?

You can self-rebook once per every disruption.

criteria.criterion: A trained service dog may travel in the cabin without a kennel if properly harnessed.
anchors: properly harnessed and do not occupy a seat
mapped_evidence_text:
Pet Carriage

Pet Carriage website link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/pet-carriage/

Live animals will not be accepted as checked-in Animal in Hold (AVIH) or Pet in Cabin (PETC) on Kenya Airways flights.

Live animals shall be consigned as cargo only.

Exception

Service Dog

Service dog shall be accepted in the cabin if it’s providing assistance to a person with disability i.e. Blind guest, a person with mental or psychiatric disorder. The dog is certified and individually trained to provide assistance to a person with a disability.

For more information on health and import documents needed to transport a service dog, contact KQ Cargo for guidance.

Note: All service dogs must be trained to be accepted. Emotional support dogs are no longer considered as service animals.

Passengers with physical, sensory, psychiatric, intellectual, or other mental disabilities who need to travel with a service dog may be required to present certain documentation from a licensed medical health professional that is treating the passenger, dated within one year, stating that the service dog is necessary for the passenger/s mental health or treatment during air travel and/or any activity at the passengers’ destination.

Service Dogs are:

[List level 1] - Accepted free of charge.

[List level 1] - They can be accepted in the cabin without a kennel/cage provided they are properly harnessed and do not occupy a seat.

[List level 1] - Service dogs are trained to behave properly. An animal that shows disruptive behavior cannot be accepted as a guide animal even if it performs assistive function for the guest.

anchors: complete the Refund form here
mapped_evidence_text:
[List level 1] - When you are in Modify My Booking, select ‘Cancel and refund’. Please be aware that if your ticket is open, all sectors will be cancelled. Choosing to Refund will cancel the whole ticket and all flights.

[List level 1] - For tickets bought on Kenya-airways.com and the inbound travel has a past date or cancelled, complete the Refund form here (Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/book-manage/manage-booking/request-for-your-refund/ ). Please note once you’ve submitted this form, your entire booking will be cancelled.

[List level 1] - The refund can only be credited to the form of payment used to make the purchase. Refunds are issued in accordance with fare conditions.

[List level 1] - For tickets bought from a preferred travel agent, please contact the agent directly to arrange your booking cancellation and refund.

[List level 1] - For tickets bought from our ticketing office and contact center, please visit any of our sales office or call the contact center directly to arrange your booking cancellation and refund.

Refund Processing Times:

[List level 1] - Kenya Airways will issue refunds for eligible tickets within 21-30 business days for credit/debit card purchases, but please note that this does not include your own bank processing time.

[List level 1] - All Refund Requests are subject to the rules of ticketed fare, and fees or penalties may apply to your Refund. Your itinerary will be CANCELLED at the time the Refund is processed.

Check My Refund Status:

[List level 1] - Please note; It is not possible to obtain a Refund by emailing Kenya Airways. A Refund can only be obtained by using one of the methods shown above.
